job.title: Field Marketing Specialist - AMER Marketing Programs
job.description:
Field Marketing Specialist – AMER Marketing Programs

Overview

Support high-impact marketing programs that connect practitioners, business leaders, and app developers with innovative data and AI solutions. As the operational engine behind virtual programs, hands-on workshops, and large-scale multi-city events across the Americas, you’ll ensure every registration page, speaker invitation, attendee list, vendor detail, and follow-up activity is accurate, timely, and ready to execute.

This role is ideal for a detail-oriented marketing professional who thrives in a fast-paced environment, enjoys coordinating multiple programs at once, and takes pride in delivering seamless experiences for attendees, speakers, sales teams, and internal stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities

  • Execute end-to-end logistics for webinars, workshops, Learning Festivals, and other virtual programs.
  • Set up registration platforms, coordinate speaker invitations and reminders, and manage run-of-show documents.
  • Provide live virtual production support and coordinate post-event on-demand content.
  • Upload post-event attendee and lead lists within 48 hours.
  • Coordinate venue logistics with external agencies for hands-on workshops across multiple AMER cities.
  • Manage registration, attendee communications, onsite materials, and event staffing.
  • Review and maintain attendee lists for multi-city programs, including list scrubbing, waitlist management, and attendee quality assurance.
  • Load attendee and lead data accurately and on time into Salesforce and Marketo.
  • Build and update landing pages, email templates, social copy, sales-facing calendar entries, and internal communications.
  • Submit purchase orders, support vendor onboarding, update budget trackers, and maintain project tools.
  • Keep program checklists, process documentation, and playbooks current.
  • Communicate program status, questions, and potential risks proactively to program owners.

Required Skills and Qualifications

  • 1–3 years of experience in marketing, event coordination, program support, or a related field.
  • Experience supporting multiple projects or programs simultaneously.
  • Hands-on experience setting up and coordinating webinars or virtual events.
  • Familiarity with registration platforms, live virtual production, and speaker logistics.
  • Strong attention to detail, particularly with attendee lists, invitations, registration data, and event materials.
  • Excellent organizational and task-management skills.
  • Ability to consistently meet deadlines, close the loop on assignments, and work independently.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to identify and communicate questions, issues, and risks early.
  • Ability to learn new tools and program requirements quickly.
  • Proficiency with Google Workspace and Excel.

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Experience supporting B2B technology marketing programs.
  • Experience with hands-on workshops, field events, or multi-city programs.
  • Familiarity with Swoogo, Marketo, Salesforce, Asana, or webinar platforms.
  • Experience managing event registration, attendee communications, and post-event data processes.
  • Experience creating or updating landing pages, email templates, social copy, or internal enablement materials.
  • Exposure to vendor coordination, purchase orders, budget tracking, or procurement processes.

Preferred Education and Experience

  • A preferred educational background was not specified.
  • 1–3 years of relevant experience in marketing, event coordination, program support, or a related area is preferred.
  • Experience in a B2B technology environment is beneficial but not required.

Other Requirements

  • Hybrid/remote position based in New York or Chicago.
  • Travel across the United States is required for in-person workshops and events.
  • Ability to support onsite event execution, including venue coordination, attendee support, materials preparation, and event staffing.
  • W2 position.

job.title: Senior Ad Technology and AI Manager
job.description:
Senior Ad Technology and AI Manager

Overview

Lead the evolution of a global digital media technology ecosystem while accelerating the practical adoption of AI across digital marketing. As a senior individual contributor, you will shape the strategy, governance, technical foundation, and roadmap for ad technology platforms and cross-channel capabilities. You will work closely with Digital Media, Analytics, Marketing Operations, Marketing Technology, Legal, Security, and agency partners to translate marketing objectives into scalable technical solutions.

This role combines deep ad technology expertise with hands-on technical execution and AI fluency. You will manage platform integrations, data connectivity, access structures, taxonomies, governance standards, and technical enablement while helping the digital team redesign workflows and operate more effectively with AI.

Required Skills and Qualifications

  • 7+ years of experience in Digital Marketing Operations, Ad Technology, Marketing Technology, or a related field.
  • Strong understanding of:
  • Ad platforms and ad servers
  • Customer data platforms (CDPs)
  • Conversion APIs
  • Identity solutions
  • Data flows between ad platforms, CDPs, and data platforms
  • Hands-on experience configuring ad platform API connections, including:
  • Creating platform applications
  • Managing tokens and credentials
  • Connecting ad platforms to CDPs or data platforms
  • Experience partnering with Analytics and Engineering teams on data pipelines and technical requirements.
  • Experience building AI-powered workflows using tools such as LLM assistants, custom GPTs, no-code agent builders, or comparable technologies.
  • Ability to lead enablement programs that encourage adoption of new AI tools and ways of working.
  • Strong background in ad technology governance, including:
  • Media taxonomies
  • Naming conventions
  • Platform access and permissions
  • Agency onboarding
  • Technical documentation
  • Security and privacy standards
  • Experience defining and testing digital marketing requirements.
  • Ability to partner with Analytics and channel teams on offline conversion and signal standards.
  • Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.
  • Strategic mindset with the ability to remain hands-on with platforms, workflows, and technical implementation.
  • Comfort working in a fast-moving environment and challenging solutions that do not meet requirements, using evidence to support recommendations.

Nice-to-Have Skills and Experience

  • Experience with Databricks Genie or comparable AI and data workspace tools.
  • Experience with CDP migrations.
  • Experience designing agentic workflows.
  • Experience with tag management systems, such as Google Tag Manager.
  • Experience with pixel implementation and GA4.
  • Experience with first-party audience segmentation.
  • Experience configuring or managing 6sense pixels and traits.
  • Experience developing AI-enabled knowledge resources, workflow automations, or digital campaign execution solutions.
  • Experience working with internal AI tiger teams or similar transformation initiatives.

Preferred Education and Experience

  • 7+ years of relevant experience in Digital Marketing Operations, Ad Technology, Marketing Technology, or a related discipline.
  • The provided role information does not specify a preferred educational degree or field of study.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the strategy, health, and roadmap of the digital media ad technology ecosystem.
  • Serve as the subject matter expert for shared and cross-channel platforms.
  • Monitor emerging platform and AI capabilities and lead technical evaluations of vendors, pilots, and agency-built tools.
  • Recommend whether solutions should be built, purchased, or delivered through existing capabilities.
  • Own the setup of ad platform API connections to data platforms and CDPs, including platform applications, tokens, credentials, and tracking configurations.
  • Partner with Analytics on data extraction, pipeline, testing, and reporting requirements once data flows into the data platform.
  • Serve as the digital team’s technical owner for tools supporting marketing goals at scale.
  • Define technical requirements and testing standards in partnership with Analytics and channel leads.
  • Establish offline conversion and signal standards.
  • Manage platform access, permissions, and global agency enablement in alignment with security, privacy, and compliance requirements.
  • Create access structures that appropriately separate agency environments and responsibilities.
  • Own global media taxonomies, governance standards, data dictionaries, QA tooling, and technical documentation.
  • Partner with Analytics to ensure technology and platform changes align with reporting needs.
  • Provide technical and strategic input for agentic workflows, including campaign execution automation, taxonomy automation, QA criteria, and future capabilities.
  • Lead AI transformation initiatives for the digital team.
  • Build practical AI solutions, such as AI workspaces, assistants, and custom workflow tools, that the team can use directly.
  • Redesign manual workflows through AI and ensure team knowledge is structured for AI-enabled use.
  • Enable team members on relevant AI and data tools.
  • Partner with Legal and Security to establish and maintain responsible AI and data privacy guardrails.
  • Train the team on AI policies and serve as the digital team’s initial point of contact for privacy-related questions.

Other Requirements

  • Work arrangement: Fully remote.
  • Time zone: Pacific Time hours preferred.
  • Engagement: 6-month contract.
  • Employment type: W2 only.
  • Start: ASAP.
  • No travel or certification requirements were specified in the provided role information.

job.title: Software Quality Tooling and Dashboarding Engineer
job.description:
Software Quality Tooling & Dashboarding Engineer

Overview

Help shape the way software quality and process compliance are measured across evolving engineering codebases. As a Software Quality Tooling & Dashboarding Engineer, you will join an Automated Driving Product Integrity team and build the pipelines, dashboards, and developer-facing tools that turn quality data into actionable insights.

This role is ideal for a self-motivated software engineer who can take ownership of prioritized backlog items, work effectively in a changing environment, and deliver reliable solutions that improve engineering visibility and workflow efficiency. You will create automated data pipelines, interactive dashboards, workflow integrations, and evidence-generation tools used to track software quality and compliance across multiple codebases.

This is a 6-month contingent worker contract with the possibility of an additional 6-month extension. The contingent worker is not a direct employee of the client organization.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build data pipelines, metric calculations, and interactive dashboards to monitor Software Quality Index and Core Process Chart compliance.
  • Develop dashboards with filters, drill-downs, trend charts, and other features that help engineering teams understand quality performance.
  • Create developer workflow automation that integrates with Jira, GitHub, and related engineering systems.
  • Develop scripts and tools that help engineering teams identify, track, and close quality and compliance gaps.
  • Automate the generation and validation of software quality, safety, and process evidence.
  • Maintain existing CI/CD and software quality tooling.
  • Support tooling across newly merged engineering codebases.
  • Maintain clear technical documentation and runbooks for metric calculations, pipelines, and internal tools.
  • Collaborate effectively with technical stakeholders while adapting to shifting priorities.
  • Execute prioritized backlog items with a focus on reliable, reproducible results.

Required Skills and Qualifications

  • 4+ years of professional software engineering experience, including substantial work with internal tooling, data pipelines, dashboards, or developer automation.
  • Advanced Python development skills.
  • Strong data processing experience, including proficiency with pandas or comparable Python data-processing workflows.
  • Demonstrated experience building interactive dashboards with filtering, drill-down, and trend-analysis capabilities.
  • Strong experience developing integrations and workflow automation using REST APIs.
  • Hands-on experience with Jira, GitHub, and Google Sheets APIs.
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and GitHub Actions.
  • Familiarity with C/C++ static analysis and code coverage tools, such as Parasoft C/C++test, CodeQL, lcov, or llvm-cov—or the ability to learn these tools quickly.
  • Strong data hygiene and attention to detail.
  • Ability to produce clear, thorough technical documentation and runbooks.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently and successfully deliver in a contract engagement.
  • Ability to adapt to evolving requirements and shifting priorities.

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Working knowledge of Bazel and Artifactory.
  • Experience in automotive or safety-critical software environments.
  • Familiarity with ISO 26262 or Automotive SPICE.
  • Experience working with Tier-1 automotive suppliers.
  • Experience supporting software quality, compliance, safety, or production-readiness programs.
  • Experience working across multiple engineering codebases or merged development environments.

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Preferred education requirements were not specified for this role.
  • 4+ years of professional software engineering experience is preferred, with demonstrated success delivering internal tools, data pipelines, dashboards, or developer automation.
  • Experience with automotive, autonomous driving, or safety-critical software environments is beneficial but not required.

Other Requirements

  • Job Type: Contract contingent worker
  • Contract Duration: 6 months, with the possibility of an additional 6-month extension
  • Target Start: January 2027
  • Work Arrangement: Remote within the United States, with an optional hybrid arrangement in Ann Arbor, Michigan
  • Availability to work 40 hours per week, Monday through Friday
  • Minimum 3-hour working-hours overlap with U.S. Pacific Time
  • Periodic early-morning or late-evening availability may be required for touchpoints with teams operating on Japan Standard Time
  • No travel is anticipated for this role

job.title: Senior Revenue Accountant/Revenue Manager
job.description:
Senior Revenue Accountant

Overview

Join a growing software organization as a Senior Revenue Accountant supporting the Revenue Accounting team during a temporary leave of absence. This hands-on, individual contributor role will play an important part in maintaining accurate revenue accounting and reporting in accordance with U.S. GAAP and ASC 606.

You will contribute to month-end close activities, revenue recognition, account reconciliations, audit support, variance analysis, and process improvement initiatives. This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced revenue accounting professional who enjoys working cross-functionally and can make an immediate impact in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

Required Skills

  • 4+ years of progressive accounting experience, including a focus on revenue recognition
  • Strong understanding of accounting and revenue recognition principles, including ASC 606
  • Experience preparing complex revenue journal entries and account reconciliations
  • Hands-on experience supporting month-end close processes
  • Experience partnering with auditors during quarterly reviews and annual audits
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills
  • Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy
  • Ability to research and explain revenue variances, including forecast-to-actual results
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently in a fast-paced, high-growth environment
  • Experience using Salesforce

Nice to Have Skills

  • Experience with Workday Financials
  • Experience with Snowflake
  • Advanced Excel and Google Sheets skills
  • Experience supporting executive reporting or board presentation materials
  • Background in public accounting
  • Experience with a publicly traded software or SaaS company
  • Experience identifying opportunities for process improvement, automation, and scalability
  • CPA license or equivalent professional certification

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in Accounting, Finance, or a related field
  • 4+ years of accounting experience with meaningful exposure to revenue accounting
  • Experience in both public accounting and industry, preferably within a public software or SaaS organization

Other Requirements

  • 100% remote position
  • Candidates should be located in the Pacific time zone or within one hour of Pacific time, or be willing to work Pacific time zone hours
  • Contract assignment expected to last approximately three months
  • Availability to begin as early as 11/30/2026 or 12/07/2026 preferred
  • Must be comfortable working as an individual contributor in a hands-on role
  • No regular travel is expected

job.title: Junior Product Manager - Finance Applications
job.description:
Junior Product Manager – Finance Applications

Overview

Join a collaborative Finance Applications team driving automation and operational improvements across an integrated suite of enterprise finance systems. In this remote role, you will help shape the roadmap for procurement, ERP, and other financial applications while partnering with finance stakeholders, engineers, product managers, business systems analysts, and external vendors.

You will translate complex business needs into scalable, secure technology solutions that streamline processes, minimize risk, and support continued growth. This role offers the opportunity to lead cross-functional initiatives, improve critical finance operations, and contribute to enhancements across platforms including Zip, Coupa, NetSuite, and other financial applications.

Required Skills and Qualifications

  • Strong knowledge of finance business processes, including:
  • Order Management
  • Billing and Collections
  • Revenue Management
  • Procurement and Expenses
  • Accounts Payable and Receivables
  • General Ledger Accounting
  • Financial Reporting
  • Deep understanding of Record-to-Report processes, including month-end accounting and financial statements and reporting in NetSuite.
  • At least 5 years of system administration experience with ERP and finance applications, including NetSuite, Workiva, Zip, Coupa, Kyriba, or FloQast.
  • At least 4 years of hands-on NetSuite configuration experience across modules and capabilities such as:
  • General Ledger
  • Intercompany
  • Fixed Assets
  • Payables and Receivables
  • Payments
  • SuiteTax
  • Custom fields, segments, lists, and records
  • SuiteFlow, SuiteScript, SuiteTalk, Suitelets, and SuiteBundles
  • Reporting
  • At least 3 years of experience supporting large-scale ERP implementations and integrations using middleware technologies such as Workato, MuleSoft, or Boomi.
  • Experience with Agile methodologies, including sprint ceremonies, backlog refinement, and Jira reporting.
  • Ability to document and analyze Procure-to-Pay processes, conduct fit-gap analyses, and translate business requirements into technical solutions.
  • Experience creating product management artifacts, including functional specifications, data flow diagrams, and business process mapping diagrams.
  • Ability to design and develop scalable workflows, automations, integrations, customizations, and reporting solutions.
  • Experience developing and executing test plans and leading integration and user acceptance testing.
  • Strong troubleshooting and production support skills, with the ability to prioritize issues based on severity and business impact.
  • Understanding of SOX compliance, system controls, and technical walkthroughs with internal or external auditors.
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple high-priority projects, meet critical deadlines, and work autonomously in a fast-paced environment.
  • Commitment to meticulous documentation, effective prioritization, and continuous learning.

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Zip certification.
  • NetSuite certification.
  • Workato or other middleware experience.
  • Kyriba experience.
  • Ironclad experience.
  • Experience in the technology industry.
  • Experience supporting multi-country and multi-currency ERP implementations.
  • Experience working at a public company.
  • Experience with SOX processes and controls.

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Preferred education was not specified in the provided job details.
  • 5+ years of experience administering ERP and finance applications.
  • 4+ years of hands-on NetSuite configuration experience.
  • 3+ years of experience with large-scale ERP implementations and middleware integrations.

Other Requirements

  • Remote position.
  • W2 employment only.
  • Anticipated initial engagement of 3 months, with the possibility of extension.
  • Ability to support an immediate start.
  • Availability to collaborate effectively with finance, accounting, engineering, product, business systems, and external vendor teams.

job.title: SAP Program Manager
job.description:
SAP Program Manager

Overview

Lead a high-impact portfolio of SAP Finance and enterprise systems initiatives for a fast-moving, commercial-stage organization preparing for multiple product launches. This hands-on contract role will drive critical work across SAP Finance, product costing, supply chain, procurement, enterprise data, contract management, and financial planning.

The SAP Program Manager will partner with Accounting, IT, Finance/FP&A, Supply Chain, external implementation partners, and SAP Application Management Services to deliver complex initiatives on an accelerated timeline. This is an ideal opportunity for an experienced systems implementation leader who can move quickly, navigate ambiguity, resolve dependencies, and provide clear direction to both executive stakeholders and delivery teams.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead multiple concurrent finance, operational, and enterprise systems initiatives from planning through delivery.
  • Drive the enterprise rollout of updated cost center structures to support product-level attribution.
  • Oversee SAP Finance initiatives involving FICO, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, General Ledger, and Profit Center Accounting.
  • Support product P&L, revenue recognition, master data, and related financial processes.
  • Lead continued rollout of direct procurement processes and Bills of Materials.
  • Oversee the extraction and integration of SAP ERP master data into an enterprise data warehouse, including data related to suppliers, cost centers, legal entities, chart of accounts, general ledger, and payments.
  • Drive implementation of a contract management system, including vendor coordination and delivery oversight.
  • Potentially lead vendor selection and implementation activities for Anaplan supporting gross-to-net revenue planning.
  • Coordinate external implementation partners and SAP Application Management Services providers.
  • Facilitate cross-functional alignment across Accounting, IT, Finance/FP&A, and Supply Chain.
  • Prepare and lead executive steering committee meetings, clearly communicating milestones, risks, dependencies, decisions, and roadmaps.
  • Identify and resolve issues quickly while maintaining delivery momentum across a high-priority portfolio.

Required Skills and Qualifications

  • Proven experience leading complex SAP Finance and enterprise systems implementations.
  • Experience leading at least 10 major enterprise system implementations end-to-end, with each implementation lasting six months or longer.
  • Hands-on systems consulting or implementation background; this role is not limited to project coordination.
  • Deep knowledge of SAP Finance, including:
  • FICO
  • Accounts Payable
  • Accounts Receivable
  • General Ledger
  • Cost Center Accounting
  • Profit Center Accounting
  • Understanding of downstream impacts involving master data, procurement, Bills of Materials, product costing, and financial reporting.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage cross-system dependencies, risks, vendors, and delivery milestones.
  • Strong executive communication and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with senior leadership.
  • High-velocity execution style and the ability to make practical decisions in a fast-moving environment.
  • Adaptability, sound judgment, and the ability to work effectively with limited bureaucracy.
  • Ability to work onsite in the San Francisco Bay Area two to three days per week, including mandatory Tuesdays and Thursdays.

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Experience in a commercial-stage biotechnology or pharmaceutical organization.
  • Familiarity with SOX compliance requirements.
  • Experience working in GxP environments.
  • Anaplan experience, particularly related to gross-to-net revenue.
  • Experience with contract management system implementations.
  • Experience with BlackLine or similar financial close management software.
  • Experience coordinating SAP Application Management Services teams and external implementation partners.

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Extensive experience leading enterprise SAP Finance and systems implementations is preferred, including 10 or more end-to-end implementations lasting at least six months each.
  • The preferred educational background was not specified for this position.

Other Requirements

  • Work arrangement: Hybrid.
  • Location: Candidates must be local to the San Francisco Bay Area.
  • Onsite schedule: Two to three days per week onsite in San Francisco, with Tuesdays and Thursdays required. Occasional flexibility to work from Palo Alto may be available.
  • Engagement: Six-month contract with strong potential for extension.
  • Start timing: Targeted for January 1.
  • Must be comfortable operating in an accelerated delivery environment with multiple concurrent workstreams and executive visibility.

job.title: Product Analyst/Project Manager
job.description:
Product Analyst/Project Manager

Overview

Drive meaningful product and pricing initiatives as a Product Analyst/Project Manager supporting enhancements and special projects within a personal lines auto product management and execution team. In this fully remote, high-visibility role, you will lead state-specific and nationwide product updates, translate business strategy into compliant and measurable implementations, and coordinate execution across business, technology, and regulatory stakeholders.

You will own implementation plans, support regulatory compliance across multiple jurisdictions, provide advanced analysis, and develop recommendations that influence product decisions and broader organizational strategy. This opportunity is well suited for a strategic, detail-oriented project leader who can solve complex problems, communicate effectively, and move initiatives forward in a dynamic environment.

Required Skills

  • Strong project management, planning, organizational, and execution skills
  • Excellent analytical, decision-making, and problem-solving abilities
  • Ability to manage state-specific and nationwide implementations across multiple jurisdictions
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to convey insights and recommendations to varied stakeholders
  • Demonstrated ability to coordinate cross-functional teams and workstreams
  • Ability to analyze trends and develop tactical and strategic recommendations
  • Keen attention to detail, particularly when reviewing research, regulatory content, filings, tools, and presentations
  • Ability to learn new concepts, processes, and tools quickly
  • Strategic mindset with the ability to connect implementation activities to broader product and organizational goals
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint
  • Experience with statistical software packages such as SAS or Emblem
  • Ability to provide training, user support, mentoring, and guidance to less experienced analysts

Nice to Have Skills

  • Technical product experience within the insurance industry
  • Personal lines or property and casualty insurance experience
  • Experience with written regulatory content or filings
  • Experience in healthcare insurance
  • Experience delivering pricing or product changes across multiple jurisdictions
  • Experience managing projects from planning through implementation and results tracking
  • Experience educating technology partners on business vision, product plans, and the impact of changes
  • Experience serving as a subject matter expert for assigned states, workstreams, or cross-functional working groups

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in mathematics, economics, statistics, or another quantitative field
  • Master’s degree is beneficial
  • Minimum of 3 years of relevant professional experience; approximately 5 years is typical
  • Experience managing projects is preferred

Other Requirements

  • Fully remote position
  • 40-hour workweek
  • 12-month contract-to-hire opportunity
  • Ability to support implementation activities across state and nationwide product initiatives
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with business, technology, regulatory, and other cross-functional partners

job.title: Technical Staff – Product Security, Advisories & Operations
job.description:
Technical Staff – Product Security, Advisories & Operations

Overview

Join a growing Product Security Incident Response Team (PSIRT) focused on protecting customers, strengthening product security, and building trust through clear, timely communication. In this role, you will operate at the intersection of vulnerability analysis, cross-functional remediation, and customer-facing transparency.

You will translate complex security findings into accurate advisories, assess real-world exploitability and impact, and coordinate remediation efforts across Engineering, Product Management, Support, Legal, and Public Relations. This is an opportunity for an analytical, detail-oriented security professional to help shape vulnerability disclosure practices, improve operational visibility, and ensure security fixes progress from discovery through release.

Required Skills

  • 2–5 years of experience in Product Security, PSIRT Operations, Application Security, Security Consulting, or Technical Program Management within a software engineering environment
  • Strong understanding of how software vulnerabilities work, including concepts related to:
  • OWASP Top 10
  • Authentication bypasses
  • Logic flaws
  • Attack-path chaining
  • Vulnerability exploitability and impact
  • Ability to evaluate real-world exploitability, potential attack paths, and blast radius across product versions
  • Familiarity with CVSS scoring concepts and vulnerability impact analysis
  • Proven ability to translate technical findings, bug reports, and architectural details into clear, authoritative documentation
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills for both technical and external audiences
  • Program management and organizational skills, including the ability to:
  • Manage multiple active advisories
  • Track remediation milestones and dependencies
  • Coordinate deadlines across multiple teams
  • Identify and remove operational bottlenecks
  • Working knowledge of the software development lifecycle
  • Understanding of patching processes and third-party library upgrades in enterprise software
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with Engineering, Product Management, Support, Legal, and Public Relations
  • Strong attention to detail, analytical thinking, and critical problem-solving skills

Nice to Have Skills

  • Experience supporting a CVE Numbering Authority (CNA) process
  • Familiarity with MITRE or FIRST vulnerability disclosure standards
  • Knowledge of VEX, CSAF, SBOM, or other modern vulnerability and software supply chain formats
  • Experience with Software Composition Analysis (SCA) tools
  • Basic scripting skills, such as Python, for vulnerability tracking, data parsing, or reporting automation
  • Hands-on experience reproducing software bugs
  • Ability to read code snippets and validate proofs of concept
  • Experience developing security playbooks, incident briefing templates, reporting dashboards, or disclosure workflows
  • Familiarity with using SBOM and asset data to improve visibility into security debt and remediation progress

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Preferred experience includes 2–5 years in Product Security, PSIRT Operations, Application Security, Security Consulting, or Technical Program Management within a software engineering environment.
  • A specific educational degree or field was not provided for this position.

Other Requirements

  • Work arrangement: Hybrid
  • Location: San Jose, CA
  • Engagement: 6-month contract
  • Employment type: W2 only
  • Start: ASAP
  • Must be able to coordinate effectively across technical and business functions in a fast-paced software engineering environment.

job.title: Revenue and Billing Specialist
job.description:
Revenue & Billing Specialist

Overview

A Palo Alto organization is seeking a detail-oriented Revenue & Billing Specialist to support critical billing, accounts receivable, and revenue operations. This role will own weekly invoicing, reconcile proof of delivery to billing records, support collections follow-up, and help maintain accurate documentation for audits and month-end close. The ideal candidate is organized, communicative, and comfortable managing recurring deadlines in a fast-paced, evolving environment.

Required Skills

  • 3–5 years of experience in billing, accounts receivable, or revenue accounting
  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field, or equivalent experience
  • Experience working with ERP systems
  • Experience reconciling subledger activity to the general ledger
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including:
  • Lookups
  • Pivot tables
  • Data validation
  • Ability to reconcile proof of delivery to invoices and identify unbilled or incorrectly billed items
  • Experience preparing and issuing invoices while ensuring billing details align with contracts and supporting documentation
  • Ability to monitor accounts receivable aging and coordinate collections follow-up
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Exceptional attention to detail and organizational skills
  • Ability to manage recurring weekly and monthly deadlines
  • Comfort working in a fast-paced, rapidly changing environment
  • Continuous improvement mindset

Nice to Have Skills

  • Experience supporting external audits
  • Experience preparing audit packages and organizing supporting documentation
  • Experience working with cross-functional teams
  • Experience using AI tools to improve reconciliations, reporting schedules, or audit preparation, with careful review for accuracy and compliance with company data-handling policies

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field
  • 3–5 years of relevant experience in billing, accounts receivable, revenue accounting, or a closely related function
  • Experience supporting month-end close activities, billing reconciliations, and accounts receivable reporting

Other Requirements

  • Ongoing contract position
  • Fully onsite in Palo Alto, five days per week
  • Expected start timeframe: late November to early December
  • Ability to support weekly invoicing, collections follow-up, audit preparation, documentation maintenance, and monthly close deadlines

job.title: Walk Up Support Desk (L1 / L2)
job.description:
Walk-Up Support Desk Technician (L1/L2)

Overview

Serve as the face of IT for corporate employees by providing responsive, hands-on support for hardware, software, connectivity, and workplace technology needs. In this onsite role, you will troubleshoot and resolve incidents, support device provisioning and replacement, maintain accurate IT asset records, and help ensure employees have a dependable technology experience. You will work under the direction of an onsite Service Desk manager or lead while contributing to daily support operations, onboarding and offboarding activities, documentation, and continuous improvement.

Required Skills

  • Experience providing hands-on technical support to internal users.
  • Ability to troubleshoot laptops, end-user devices, hardware, software, and network-access issues.
  • Ability to perform hardware break/fix, device swaps, replacements, and related support tasks.
  • Familiarity with monitoring and updating service tickets through a support queue.
  • Ability to install licensed software and provision user access to software applications.
  • Ability to support standard employee onboarding and offboarding processes.
  • Experience tracking and maintaining physical IT hardware inventory.
  • Strong customer service and communication skills.
  • Ability to work effectively under the direction of a Service Desk manager or lead.
  • Ability to support workplace technology, including conference room audiovisual equipment, Wi-Fi, badge readers, and cameras.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail when handling equipment and support documentation.
  • Ability to provide professional, responsive assistance to employees experiencing IT-related issues.

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Experience supporting collaboration tools and improving end-user technology experiences.
  • Experience with IT hardware and software procurement or asset management practices.
  • Experience creating training materials, documentation, or learning resources for support processes.
  • Experience working with IT, Finance, or leadership teams on technology spending and asset-related activities.
  • Experience in a corporate or office-based IT support environment.

Preferred Education and Experience

Preferred education and experience requirements were not provided. Candidates should demonstrate practical experience providing end-user IT support and performing the hardware, software, inventory, and service desk functions described above.

Other Requirements

  • Work arrangement: Onsite walk-up support desk role.
  • Schedule: Monday through Friday during normal business hours, such as 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m.
  • Must be able to provide direct, in-person assistance to corporate employees.
  • Must be able to handle, track, secure, and maintain physical IT equipment.
  • Must be able to perform repetitive operational tasks, including hardware imaging, device swaps, and inventory counts.
  • Specific work location, travel requirements, and certification requirements were not provided.

job.title: Recruiting Coordinator
job.description:
Recruiting Coordinator

Overview

Join a collaborative Talent team as a Recruiting Coordinator and help shape an exceptional candidate experience from first contact through the interview process. In this high-impact role, you’ll partner with recruiters, sourcers, hiring managers, and business stakeholders to coordinate a high volume of phone, virtual, and onsite interviews across technical and non-technical roles.

You’ll bring structure, urgency, and attention to detail to a fast-paced environment while identifying opportunities to improve recruiting operations. As a key point of contact for the Coordination team, you’ll help drive projects, refine processes, and support scalable programs that strengthen hiring efforts. This opportunity is ideal for an organized and ambitious recruiting professional who is interested in developing leadership skills and growing toward future people-management responsibilities.

Required Skills

  • 4+ years of experience in a fast-paced environment managing multiple priorities, ideally in recruiting coordination
  • Demonstrated experience scheduling interviews using ATS and scheduling tools
  • Strong scheduling and calendar-management skills
  • Ability to balance a high sense of urgency with meticulous attention to detail
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Strong customer service mindset and professional presence
  • Ability to build rapport with candidates and internal business partners
  • Self-directed approach with the ability to take ownership of projects and initiatives
  • Ability to coordinate onsite, virtual, and phone interviews for a high volume of candidates
  • Strong organizational, problem-solving, and process-improvement skills

Nice to Have Skills

  • Experience working with multiple ATS and scheduling platforms
  • Proficiency with Google Workspace
  • Experience hosting onsite candidates and supporting an exceptional onsite experience
  • Experience analyzing recruiting or operational data
  • Background identifying process inefficiencies and implementing improvements
  • Experience partnering with recruiting leaders, hiring managers, and business stakeholders
  • Demonstrated interest in mentoring or developing others

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree preferred
  • 4+ years of experience in recruiting coordination or a similarly fast-paced, high-volume operational environment

Other Requirements

  • Work arrangement: Hybrid
  • Location: Foster City, CA
  • Employment type: W2 only
  • Ability to support onsite, virtual, and phone interview scheduling
  • Availability to begin as soon as possible
  • Contract duration of approximately 12 months

job.title: Sr. Manager/Director Accounting
job.description:
Sr. Manager/Director, Accounting

Overview

A growing marketing and technology services organization is seeking a hands-on Sr. Manager/Director, Accounting to support critical accounting operations during an important period of growth and transition. This role will play a key part in the month-end close, audit and tax support, financial reporting, process improvement, and ongoing enhancement of accounting systems and controls.

The ideal candidate brings strong general ledger expertise, substantial audit experience, and the ability to work strategically while also stepping into transactional accounting responsibilities when needed. This is a 3+ month contract-to-hire opportunity with an immediate start.

Required Skills

  • Strong accounting background with comprehensive general ledger knowledge
  • Experience supporting month-end close, including:
  • Reviewing and approving journal entries
  • Completing account reconciliations
  • Preparing supplemental monthly reporting schedules
  • Performing balance sheet and income statement variance analysis
  • Significant audit experience, including supporting external audit activities
  • Experience documenting accounting controls and processes
  • Ability to identify and implement process improvements that increase efficiency
  • Hands-on experience with NetSuite
  • Experience with NetSuite implementation activities, including data migration and data validation
  • Ability to review and approve accounts payable and payment processes
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and communication skills
  • Willingness to perform hands-on transactional accounting work as needed
  • Experience preparing ad hoc reporting for departments and organizational leaders

Nice to Have Skills

  • Payroll experience
  • Experience supporting tax preparation for U.S. entities
  • Experience with Bill.com
  • Experience with Expensify
  • Experience working in Google Workspace
  • Background in marketing, technology, professional services, or a similarly fast-paced environment

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Senior-level accounting management experience with a strong foundation in general ledger accounting, financial close, audit support, and accounting operations
  • Experience managing or supporting accounting system implementations, including data migration and validation
  • Education requirements were not specified in the provided information.

Other Requirements

  • Work arrangement: Fully remote during the contract period
  • Candidates must be able to work onsite if the role converts to a permanent position:
  • Culver City is the preferred location
  • San Francisco availability approximately two days per week may be required
  • A less frequent onsite schedule, potentially once per month, may be considered depending on the candidate
  • Contract duration is expected to be 3+ months, with strong potential for conversion
  • Availability to start as soon as possible
  • Must be comfortable balancing strategic accounting responsibilities with hands-on execution

job.title: Test Technician
job.description:
Test Technician — Electrical Systems Integration

Overview

Join a high-performance Electrical Systems Integration team working at the forefront of complex electrical, electronic, and mechatronic system testing. As a Test Technician, you will operate test bucks and Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) electrical systems, execute detailed test plans, flash firmware, build and repair wiring harnesses, and troubleshoot electrical and mechanical issues.

This hands-on role is ideal for a technician who takes pride in craftsmanship, enjoys solving challenging problems, and wants to collaborate with system owners, firmware developers, test engineers, and fellow technicians to deliver reliable, high-performing systems. You will contribute to the design, fabrication, integration, and testing of test fixtures and robotic systems in stationary and dynamometer environments.

Required Skills

  • Experience executing test plans on electrical systems, test bucks, or related hardware
  • Ability to flash firmware to vehicle components and accurately track software changes and updates
  • Proven ability to read electrical schematics
  • Experience fabricating, pinning out, assembling, repairing, and troubleshooting wiring harnesses
  • Hands-on proficiency with electrical engineering lab equipment, including:
  • Digital multimeters
  • Power supplies
  • Oscilloscopes
  • General ability to diagnose and troubleshoot fundamental electrical and mechanical issues
  • Experience assembling and testing electro-mechanical systems
  • Ability to fabricate and assemble test fixtures using CAD models and engineering drawings
  • Strong communication and coordination skills when working with test requesters and cross-functional teams
  • Attention to detail and pride in producing high-quality, reliable work

Nice to Have Skills

  • Experience operating Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) systems
  • Familiarity with dSPACE systems
  • Experience diagnosing CAN bus or automotive Ethernet network issues
  • Previous experience working safely with automotive high-voltage systems
  • Experience building and testing robotic systems, test bucks, or other specialized test fixtures
  • Background in automotive, robotics, electrical systems integration, or a related technical environment

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Associate degree or higher in Electrical Technology, Electronics Technology, or a related field
  • Equivalent hands-on technical education and experience will be considered
  • Experience assembling, integrating, and testing electro-mechanical systems
  • Experience reading schematics and building or repairing wiring harnesses
  • Candidates with strong foundational electronics and troubleshooting skills may be considered for training on specialized firmware flashing and HIL tools

Other Requirements

  • Work arrangement: Fully onsite in Foster City, California
  • Employment type: W2 only
  • Duration: 12-month assignment with potential for extension and possible conversion
  • Openings: Two positions available
  • Ability to work hands-on in a lab and test environment
  • Must be able to follow detailed test procedures and document test results and configuration changes accurately

job.title: Accounting Manager (Revenue)
job.description:
Accounting Manager (Revenue) — Fully Remote Contract Opportunity

Overview

Support critical year-end and post-close accounting activities as an Accounting Manager focused on revenue operations. This individual contributor role will take ownership of reconciliations, supporting schedules, and fluctuation analysis across revenue, deferred revenue, and accounts receivable. Reporting to the Revenue Director, you’ll work independently within a collaborative accounting team and help ensure accurate, well-supported financial close processes.

This fully remote assignment is expected to last approximately 4–5 months, with potential for extension and consideration for a permanent opportunity based on business needs and performance. The position is available for an immediate start, and candidates may work from a variety of time zones while supporting local working hours.

Responsibilities

  • Reconcile revenue, deferred revenue, and accounts receivable balances.
  • Investigate discrepancies and coordinate resolution with accounting team members.
  • Prepare and review supporting schedules for revenue and deferred revenue during month-end and year-end close.
  • Analyze quarter-over-quarter and year-over-year changes by line item.
  • Document the underlying drivers of fluctuations in revenue, deferred revenue, and accounts receivable balances.
  • Use NetSuite to obtain transaction detail, validate balances, and prepare accounting analyses.
  • Support financial reporting activities, including occasional use of Workiva.
  • Independently manage assigned manager-level accounting work from analysis through resolution.

Required Skills

  • Hands-on experience with operational revenue accounting, deferred revenue, and accounts receivable.
  • Proven ability to independently own reconciliations and accounting close responsibilities.
  • Strong experience performing fluctuation, flux, and variance analysis and explaining balance changes by line item.
  • Strong Excel skills.
  • Hands-on NetSuite experience is a high-priority requirement.
  • Ability to investigate discrepancies, identify root causes, and coordinate effective resolutions.
  • Experience supporting month-end and year-end close activities.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently in a fully remote environment.

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Experience in a SaaS, cybersecurity, technology, or software environment.
  • Familiarity with Workiva.
  • General ledger accounting experience in addition to revenue accounting.
  • Oracle experience.
  • Experience with NetSuite ARM.
  • Exposure to revenue recognition, contract review, or related technical accounting activities. These areas are beneficial but outside the immediate primary scope of the assignment.
  • Experience improving accounting processes and strengthening operational controls.

Preferred Education and Experience

  • The specific educational requirement was not provided.
  • Preferred candidates will bring manager-level experience in operational accounting, with a strong background in revenue, deferred revenue, accounts receivable, and general ledger activities.
  • Experience supporting year-end close and subsequent monthly close cycles is strongly preferred.

Other Requirements

  • Fully remote position.
  • Candidates may work across different time zones while supporting local working hours.
  • Immediate availability is preferred.
  • Assignment duration is expected to be approximately 4–5 months, with potential for extension.
  • Some year-end coverage may be needed around January 2.
  • Planned days off include Thanksgiving Day and the following Friday, Christmas Eve and Christmas Day, and January 1 and 2.

job.title: Director, Finance Transformation
job.description:
Finance Transformation Lead

Overview

A premier biotechnology organization is seeking a strategic, highly technical Finance Transformation Lead to drive end-to-end transformation across a rapidly scaling global business. This pivotal role will establish an integrated financial roadmap, optimize a sophisticated enterprise technology environment, and champion process efficiency, automation, and practical AI applications across the finance organization.

The ideal candidate combines deep finance systems expertise with hands-on operational leadership and a strong ability to translate strategy into scalable execution. This leader will help build dimensional reporting frameworks, strengthen governance, align cross-functional priorities, and shape the future financial operating model as the organization advances its commercial growth.

Required Skills

  • 10+ years of progressive finance leadership experience, including significant experience in finance transformation, process optimization, and operational strategy within complex, fast-growing organizations
  • Proven success designing, building, and executing integrated financial roadmaps across FP&A, Accounting, Tax, and Operations
  • Deep expertise evaluating, optimizing, and maximizing enterprise technology stacks, including platforms such as SAP S/4HANA, Oracle EPM, Vertex, Workday, Ariba, or Coupa
  • Extensive experience leading cross-functional transformation projects and digitalization initiatives
  • Demonstrated ability to leverage AI and automation to improve financial operations
  • Strong background implementing scalable financial processes, dimensional reporting structures, and governance frameworks across business units, products, and geographies
  • Exceptional project management and stakeholder-alignment skills
  • Strong executive communication skills, with the ability to drive both strategic vision and detailed execution
  • Proven ability to provide matrixed leadership and guidance across cross-functional teams
  • Hands-on, operational mindset with a strong focus on continuous improvement and measurable results

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Direct experience in the biopharmaceutical, life sciences, or high-growth commercialized technology sectors
  • Experience building and mentoring high-performing finance transformation teams from the ground up
  • Background helping organizations transition from rapid-scale or pandemic-growth phases to mature, efficient operating models
  • Experience developing or leading a finance transformation center of excellence
  • Familiarity with complex global commercial operations and reporting requirements

Preferred Education and Experience

  • 10+ years of progressive finance leadership and transformation experience is preferred.
  • Preferred educational background was not specified.

Other Requirements

  • Hybrid position based in Cambridge, MA, requiring onsite work 3–4 days per week
  • Willingness to work extended hours as needed; core working hours are generally 8:00 a.m.–6:00 p.m.
  • Ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, evolving organization and commit the time required to lead complex transformation initiatives
  • Strong leadership presence and the ability to influence stakeholders at all levels
  • Certification requirements were not specified.

job.title: Accounting Manager
job.description:
Accounting Manager

Overview

Take ownership of a hands-on accounting function within a fast-paced, startup-like consumer ecommerce environment. This Accounting Manager role is ideal for an experienced accounting professional who enjoys working independently, improving processes, and driving accurate, timely financial operations.

Reporting to the VP of Finance, you will lead the month-end close, oversee account reconciliations, maintain prepaid schedules, and support key audit and tax initiatives. You will also play an important role in transitioning the organization’s fiscal year-end from September 30 to December 31, including supporting an additional tax return.

This is a 3–6 month contract-to-hire opportunity with a collaborative, down-to-earth team.

Required Skills

  • Strong hands-on accounting experience, including:
  • Month-end close
  • Account reconciliations
  • Prepaid schedules
  • Proficiency with QuickBooks Online
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills
  • Ability to work independently and take ownership of responsibilities
  • Strong accountability, follow-through, and attention to detail
  • Ability to manage tight deadlines in a fast-paced environment
  • Willingness to learn and adapt
  • Experience creating and maintaining accounting process documentation

Nice to Have Skills

  • Experience with Tableau
  • Experience supporting annual financial audits
  • Experience assisting with tax-related activities
  • Experience managing or supporting fiscal year-end transitions
  • Background working in a small to midsize business, particularly an organization with approximately $50 million in revenue
  • Experience in a startup-like or high-growth environment

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Significant accounting experience with a strong emphasis on close, reconciliations, and prepaids
  • Experience in a small to midsize business environment is strongly preferred
  • Specific educational requirements were not provided

Other Requirements

  • Work arrangement: Hybrid; onsite approximately 2–3 days per week
  • Location: Redwood City, California area
  • Employment type: Contract-to-hire
  • Ability to begin as soon as possible
  • Ability to support the transition from a September 30 fiscal year-end to a December 31 fiscal year-end
  • Ability to support annual audit activities and related tax requirements

job.title: Senior Accountant
job.description:
Senior Accountant

Overview

Join a growing Finance organization as a hands-on Senior Accountant supporting general ledger accounting, financial reporting, and month-end close activities. This role offers the opportunity to apply broad accounting expertise, improve financial processes, and collaborate with teams across Operations, Sales, Program Management, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Engineering, and FP&A.

The Senior Accountant will help ensure accurate and timely financial reporting, maintain key accounting schedules, and support compliance in a fast-paced environment. This is a contract-to-hire opportunity based in Alameda, CA.

Responsibilities

  • Support the end-to-end month-end close process and draft monthly financial statements.
  • Prepare journal entries, account reconciliations, and supporting schedules.
  • Reconcile bank accounts, debt, and interest earned.
  • Maintain prepaid expense schedules and calculate and post monthly amortization entries.
  • Support system allocations by verifying and updating key cost drivers in NetSuite.
  • Manage revenue recognition workflows under ASC 606, including invoicing and collections support.
  • Maintain lease accounting schedules and perform monthly journal entries and reconciliations under ASC 842.
  • Ensure compliance with internal controls and maintain clear, well-supported audit documentation.
  • Monitor debt covenants and support banking activities as needed.
  • Provide guidance and support to staff accountants when necessary.
  • Identify opportunities to improve accounting processes and reduce the time required to complete recurring tasks.
  • Collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams to support accurate and timely financial insights.

Required Skills and Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
  • 5–7+ years of progressive accounting experience.
  • Strong hands-on experience with general ledger accounting and month-end close.
  • Experience preparing journal entries, account reconciliations, financial statements, and audit schedules.
  • In-depth knowledge of and practical experience applying ASC 606 and ASC 842.
  • Advanced Excel skills.
  • Required hands-on experience with NetSuite.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Public accounting experience.
  • Experience with lease accounting, revenue recognition, cash reconciliations, and process improvement.
  • Experience with Flocast.
  • CPA certification, either active or in progress.
  • Experience supporting debt covenant monitoring, banking functions, or internal control compliance.
  • Experience in a technology, manufacturing, defense, or other complex operating environment.

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting or Finance preferred.
  • 5–7+ years of progressive accounting experience preferred.
  • Candidates with either public accounting or strong industry accounting experience are encouraged to apply.
  • CPA certification or progress toward certification is a plus.

Other Requirements

  • Worksite: Hybrid in Alameda, CA.
  • Schedule: Three days onsite per week, including Wednesdays. The remaining two onsite days may be selected by the employee.
  • Employment type: Contract-to-hire.
  • Ability to work onsite as required and collaborate effectively with the Finance team.

job.title: Infrastructure Consultant
job.description:
Infrastructure Consultant

Overview

Lead the execution of a global employee onboarding program and help shape impactful talent development experiences in this six-month consulting opportunity. The Infrastructure Consultant will translate strategic objectives into actionable project plans, coordinate cross-functional teams, support Workday-enabled process improvements, and drive change adoption across a global organization.

This role is part of a collaborative People Development team focused on empowering employees, improving onboarding experiences, and delivering scalable learning solutions. The ideal candidate is a strategic, execution-oriented professional who can manage complex initiatives, engage stakeholders across functions and regions, and navigate ambiguity while delivering measurable results.

Required Skills

  • 5+ years of experience in HR program management, learning and development, organizational development, talent development, or a related HR function
  • Experience leading or supporting employee onboarding programs
  • Strong project management skills, including the ability to manage project plans, milestones, timelines, dependencies, risks, and deliverables
  • Demonstrated change management experience, including:
  • Stakeholder communications
  • Training materials
  • Readiness planning
  • Adoption strategies
  • Hands-on experience with Workday, including testing, configuration support, process improvement, or implementation activities
  • Experience coordinating cross-functional teams and managing multiple stakeholders
  • Experience working in a global and cross-functional environment
  • Excellent organizational, communication, collaboration, and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to influence stakeholders across functions and levels
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to manage competing priorities
  • Self-directed, execution-oriented approach with the ability to anticipate challenges and resolve issues proactively

Nice to Have Skills

  • Experience supporting global onboarding programs across multiple regions
  • Background in learning solution management or talent development initiatives
  • Experience gathering stakeholder feedback and measuring program effectiveness
  • Familiarity with related HR technology platforms
  • Experience developing continuous improvement strategies for HR programs and processes
  • Experience working with geographically distributed teams

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in human resources, organizational development, business administration, learning and development, or a related field preferred
  • 5+ years of relevant professional experience in HR program management, learning and development, organizational development, talent development, or a related discipline

Other Requirements

  • Six-month consulting assignment
  • W2 engagement
  • Hybrid position based in Durham, NC, with three days per week onsite
  • Must be able to collaborate effectively with global teams across regions and time zones
  • Must be comfortable managing complex initiatives, shifting priorities, and multiple concurrent deliverables

job.title: Sr. AP Specialist
job.description:
Sr. AP Specialist

Overview

A growing biotechnology organization is seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented Sr. AP Specialist to take ownership of its full accounts payable function. This role will manage high-volume invoice processing, vendor relationships, corporate card and expense programs, payment activities, reconciliations, and AP-related close support.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on accounting professional who brings exceptional accuracy, strong documentation skills, sound judgment, and the confidence to clarify details and ask thoughtful questions. This is an opportunity to make a meaningful impact by strengthening processes, supporting internal controls, and helping scale accounting operations in a fast-paced environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the full accounts payable lifecycle, including invoice processing, coding, approvals, payment processing, and vendor reconciliations.
  • Process a high volume of invoices—approximately 800 per month—through Coupa, NetSuite, InvoiceSmash, and other electronic platforms.
  • Manage AP and invoice inquiry mailboxes, responding promptly to vendor and internal requests.
  • Prepare and execute weekly payment runs, ACH batches, and wire transfer documentation in accordance with approval requirements.
  • Manage recurring invoices, payment transactions, and vendor prepayments.
  • Reconcile vendor statements, investigate discrepancies, and resolve outstanding invoice and payment issues.
  • Partner with Procurement to maintain accurate vendor records, tax documentation, and approval workflows.
  • Support 1099 compliance, including vendor record reviews and annual filing activities.
  • Coordinate vendor outreach to support accruals and financial close.
  • Administer the corporate card program through Ramp, including employee activity and spending-limit monitoring.
  • Review and approve expense reports submitted through Ramp and Expensify for accuracy, coding, receipts, and policy compliance.
  • Follow up with employees regarding missing receipts and supporting documentation.
  • Support employee onboarding and training related to expense management and corporate card policies.
  • Prepare and post journal entries, account reclassifications, and expense allocations as needed.
  • Create and maintain prepaid amortization schedules in NetSuite.
  • Perform monthly reconciliations of AP aging, corporate card balances, and related general ledger accounts.
  • Support month-end, quarter-end, and year-end close activities.
  • Assist with cash reconciliations, recurring direct debits, intercompany or interbank cash transfers, and payment-related banking activities.
  • Prepare recurring reports and analyses related to corporate card usage, vendor spending, and software license utilization.
  • Provide documentation and support for internal and external audits.
  • Develop and maintain standard operating procedures and desktop procedures for AP processes.
  • Identify opportunities to streamline workflows, improve efficiency, and automate manual processes.
  • Participate in system implementations, workflow enhancements, and other accounting process improvement initiatives.

Required Skills and Qualifications

  • 5–7+ years of accounts payable and/or general accounting experience.
  • Strong understanding of full-cycle accounts payable, vendor management, and internal controls.
  • Demonstrated ability to process high volumes of invoices accurately and efficiently.
  • Hands-on experience with Coupa, NetSuite, Ramp, and Expensify.
  • Experience supporting month-end close, general ledger reconciliations, and financial reporting.
  • Working knowledge of 1099 reporting requirements and vendor compliance.
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including PivotTables, XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP, SUMIFS, and data analysis.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, problem-solving, and documentation skills.
  • Ability to independently manage competing priorities and meet deadlines.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to clarify discrepancies, ask appropriate questions, and follow issues through to resolution.
  • Dependable, proactive, and comfortable working with minimal supervision.
  • Ability to handle confidential financial information with discretion and professionalism.

Nice to Have Skills

  • General ledger experience, including journal entries, reclassifications, expense allocations, and account reconciliations.
  • Experience with prepaid amortization schedules and AP-related flux analysis.
  • Familiarity with electronic invoice processing systems and automated approval workflows.
  • Experience supporting accounting process improvements, system implementations, or workflow automation.
  • Experience preparing standard operating procedures and desktop procedures.
  • Background in biotechnology, life sciences, pharmaceutical, or another high-growth environment.
  • Experience supporting internal or external audits.

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field preferred.
  • Five to seven or more years of progressive accounts payable and/or general accounting experience preferred.
  • Experience in a high-growth organization with evolving processes and operational priorities is beneficial.

Other Requirements

  • Work arrangement: Hybrid, with three onsite days per week.
  • Remote candidates may be considered for the contract period but must be available to work Pacific Time Zone hours.
  • Contract duration: Approximately five months, with potential contract-to-hire consideration.
  • Anticipated start date: December 1.

job.title: Sr Accounting Manager or Director of Accounting (part time)
job.description:
Sr. Accounting Manager or Director of Accounting — Part-Time Consultant

Overview

A growing technology organization supporting sensitive government contracts is seeking an experienced Sr. Accounting Manager or Director of Accounting to oversee core accounting operations, general ledger management, and the monthly close process. This part-time consulting opportunity is ideal for a hands-on accounting leader who can operate independently, partner effectively with an international finance operations team, and bring structure, accuracy, and scalability to a fast-moving SaaS environment.

The successful candidate will serve as both a strategic partner and individual contributor, taking ownership of reporting, compliance, audit preparation, process improvement, and cross-functional communication. This role offers flexible working hours aligned primarily with Pacific Time and the opportunity to work onsite periodically in the San Francisco area.

Required Skills and Qualifications

  • Demonstrated ownership of the full monthly close and financial reporting process
  • Strong general ledger, reconciliations, financial statement, and variance analysis experience
  • Experience preparing insightful monthly reporting packages, including period-over-period and budget-to-actual analysis
  • Background supporting audit preparation and serving as a primary contact for external auditors
  • Experience with tax reporting activities, including income tax and sales tax support
  • Prior people management or team leadership experience
  • Experience working with an international or offshore finance operations team
  • Strong SaaS and/or software accounting experience in a startup or small-company environment
  • Excellent problem identification, root-cause analysis, and decision-making skills
  • Ability to build trust with stakeholders and effectively partner with business leaders
  • Highly responsive, organized, self-motivated, and capable of driving projects through completion
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with a commitment to clear documentation and transparency
  • High level of integrity, accountability, discretion, and attention to detail
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and adapt effectively in a rapidly changing environment
  • Positive, solutions-oriented attitude and willingness to take ownership of both routine responsibilities and ad hoc projects
  • Demonstrated interest in process development, workflow automation, and continuous improvement
  • Experience using accounting and business systems such as NetSuite, Ramp, Expensify, Salesforce, Navan, Google Workspace, or similar platforms
  • Ability to incorporate AI tools thoughtfully and effectively into accounting workflows
  • U.S. citizenship required due to the organization’s work supporting sensitive government defense contracts

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • CPA certification
  • NetSuite implementation, optimization, or advanced administration experience
  • Experience with Bill.com or similar accounts payable and payment platforms
  • Experience working in a venture-backed, high-growth, or rapidly scaling technology company
  • Experience developing and improving accounting policies, procedures, and internal controls
  • Experience supporting government contractors or organizations with compliance-sensitive operations
  • Familiarity with AI-enabled productivity and accounting tools
  • Experience communicating financial trends and business drivers to executive stakeholders

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field
  • CPA certification preferred
  • Approximately 5–8 years of progressive accounting experience
  • Experience spanning both public accounting and corporate accounting environments
  • Previous experience managing an accounting team while also contributing as a hands-on individual contributor
  • Proven experience leading month-end close, financial reporting, audit support, and accounting operations for a SaaS or software organization

Other Requirements

  • Part-time consulting engagement expected to last at least three months, with potential for extension based on business needs
