job.title: Senior Software Engineer - AI Development Tooling & Data Architecture
job.description:
Senior Software Engineer – AI Development Tooling & Data Architecture

Overview

Build the systems that make AI-assisted software development more reliable—and help establish how complex clinical data can be understood, measured, linked, and responsibly used. This fully remote role offers two entry points: AI development tooling or data architecture. You do not need to be an expert in both areas; depth in one, combined with strong reasoning and curiosity about the other, is enough to succeed.

You’ll create durable engineering practices that turn requirements, architectural decisions, data contracts, and measurement definitions into tools and models teams can trust. The work emphasizes evidence, reproducibility, clear technical writing, and sound judgment over familiarity with a particular technology stack or quantity of code produced.

Required Skills

  • Strong production experience with Python.
  • Ability to learn unfamiliar technical or business domains, identify important questions, and revise conclusions when evidence changes.
  • Strong evidence-based reasoning, including the ability to distinguish:
  • Measurements from inferences
  • Proposals from decisions
  • Structural possibility from demonstrated capability
  • Ability to turn grammars, contracts, invariants, type systems, or measurement definitions into useful tools and models.
  • Clear technical writing skills, with experience creating design documents, assessments, specifications, or decision records.
  • Independent delivery and sound judgment, including recognizing when a design decision or formal approval is required.
  • Experience using AI coding assistants, along with the judgment to identify plausible but incorrect, incomplete, or architecturally damaging output.
  • For the AI development tooling track:
  • Experience with Python’s standard library and ast, or equivalent code-as-data and program-analysis work.
  • For the data architecture track:
  • Strong SQL skills and analytical reasoning.
  • Deep understanding of data grain, joins, denominators, and population comparability.
  • Evidence of substantial self-directed learning followed by practical application.

Nice-to-Have Skills

Experience in one or more of the following areas is beneficial:

  • Static analysis, linters, codemods, or architecture-rule tooling
  • Schema-driven code generation
  • Property-based, golden, mutation, or contract testing
  • Model-graded evaluation, probe design, or measurement of nondeterministic systems
  • Data modeling, data catalogs, lineage, record linkage, dbt, Spark, or schema languages
  • Declarative rules, domain-specific languages, constraint systems, or information theory
  • Reproducible tooling that produces deterministic, fail-closed results
  • Architecture decision records and automated checks that enforce technical decisions
  • Clinical, healthcare, veterinary, or other complex domain data environments

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Formal degree requirements are not specified for this role.
  • A minimum number of years of experience is not required.
  • Candidates should demonstrate substantial practical experience in either AI development tooling or data architecture, supported by strong reasoning and the ability to deliver independently.
  • Experience with the organization’s exact technology stack is not required.
  • Machine learning or veterinary experience is not required.

Key Responsibilities

AI Development Tooling

  • Build architecture checks that compare source-tree versions across distinct dimensions and provide supporting evidence rather than a single score.
  • Develop static analysis for Python code, including checks for duplication, dependency cycles, boundary violations, exception-handling risks, and other structural issues.
  • Create reproducible, fail-closed tools that generate identical reports from identical inputs.
  • Ensure checks that cannot run never count as passing.
  • Connect architecture decision records to enforceable gates with verifiable identities, statuses, and references.
  • Generate types, constants, and validators from a single source of truth using schema-driven development.
  • Create golden fixtures that document expected behavior.
  • Develop reproducible model-graded probes and audits while making limitations and unevaluated cases explicit.

Data Architecture

  • Characterize clinical data sources by separately establishing what exists, what is populated, what can be linked, and what may legitimately be used.
  • Create versioned, per-table contracts that generate reference views, inventories, coverage reports, and data explorers.
  • Define reproducible measurements, including grain, time windows, deduplication, exclusions, unresolved cases, populations, and denominators.
  • Assess whether populations and denominators are comparable before results are compared.
  • Design safe approaches for analyzing large-scale data, including estimating query costs before accessing multi-terabyte tables.
  • Return aggregates or metadata instead of records when appropriate.
  • Evaluate existing components against requirements and reason carefully about cross-system identity.
  • Assess logical models, storage, and serving as related but separate architectural decisions.

How You’ll Work

  • Use AI agents throughout development while keeping product ownership, architecture, engineering, requirements, and implementation responsibilities distinct.
  • Define product behavior and technical decisions before implementation.
  • Document requirements, behavior, architecture decisions, detailed specifications, and implementation plans in proportion to the change.
  • Treat agents as sources of investigation and recommendations; people retain approval and authorization responsibilities.
  • Use independent reviews, source checks, and executable tests to verify that instructions are clear, claims are supported, and results meet requirements.
  • Stop affected work when decisions are missing, evidence conflicts, or instructions are unclear until the issue is resolved or an authorized temporary deviation is documented.
  • Verify completion through recorded evidence that all required checks have passed.

What Success Looks Like

  • First 30 days: Ship a small, useful check, measurement, or contract with documentation that makes the work reviewable.
  • By 90 days: Own a defined area and become a trusted resource for it.
  • By the end of the engagement: Leave behind work that is adopted, documented, and maintainable by the team.

Other Requirements

  • Work arrangement: Fully remote.
  • Time zone alignment: Eastern Time (EST).
  • Engagement: Six-month contract.
  • Employment type: W2 only.
  • Start: As soon as possible.
  • Depth in either AI development tooling or data architecture, combined with strong reasoning and curiosity about the other area, is sufficient to apply.

job.title: Fleet Support Engineer - Thermal
job.description:
Fleet Support Engineer – Thermal

Overview

Support the reliability, safety, and operational uptime of an advanced vehicle fleet as a Fleet Support Engineer – Thermal. In this hands-on role, you will serve as a primary technical resource for real-time thermal-system escalations, diagnosing complex issues across HVAC, coolant loops, radiators, fans, pumps, refrigerant systems, battery cooling, and compute cooling.

You will work closely with field technicians and cross-functional engineering teams to identify root causes, implement corrective actions, validate repairs, and prevent recurring issues. This role is ideal for a proactive engineer who can move seamlessly between fleet-level data analysis, vehicle-level troubleshooting, and component-level diagnostics in a fast-paced service environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Serve as the primary technical point of contact for thermal-management escalations involving:
  • HVAC and cabin climate systems
  • Coolant loops, pumps, radiators, fans, and heat exchangers
  • Refrigerant systems
  • Battery and power-electronics cooling
  • Compute thermal systems
  • Conduct root cause analysis and implement interim and permanent corrective actions for thermal faults.
  • Distinguish true thermal degradation from transient or power-state-driven warnings.
  • Diagnose issues involving coolant pump performance, coolant leaks, air entrapment, refrigerant charge, radiator and fan operation, and temperature-threshold faults.
  • Direct and validate coolant service procedures, including filling, bleeding, air purging, and post-repair thermal stress testing before vehicle release.
  • Develop and maintain comprehensive troubleshooting guides for thermal components.
  • Validate and perform component and vehicle bring-up and functional verification procedures.
  • Differentiate base-vehicle thermal faults from autonomy and compute thermal faults to guide the appropriate diagnostic path.
  • Analyze fleet telemetry and large datasets to identify systematic thermal issues and recommend preventative actions.
  • Collaborate effectively with technicians, engineers, and cross-functional teams in real-time operational settings.

Required Skills and Qualifications

  • At least 2 years of relevant experience in transportation, aerospace, autonomous vehicles, or a related field, with a focus on thermal management, HVAC, or cooling systems.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Automotive Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • Hands-on experience with thermal systems, including coolant loops, pumps, radiators, heat exchangers, HVAC, and refrigerant handling.
  • Ability to safely troubleshoot low-voltage and high-voltage systems, including battery and power-electronics cooling.
  • Proficiency interpreting electrical schematics, harness diagrams, and coolant or thermal-system diagrams.
  • Experience debugging Unified Diagnostic Services (UDS) issues.
  • Strong root cause analysis and component-level troubleshooting skills.
  • Ability to take a holistic approach to vehicle-system problems and drive resolutions from high-level functions to individual components.
  • Proactive, self-directed working style with strong communication and relationship-building skills.
  • Ability to provide clear technical support during real-time fleet operations.

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Familiarity with CAN bus messaging related to thermal and HVAC systems.
  • Experience with electric vehicle technology, including battery and power-electronics thermal management.
  • Experience using thermal simulation or data-logging tools.
  • Experience remotely supporting vehicle troubleshooting.
  • Experience with Linux and Python-based systems for fleet-level data processing.

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Automotive Engineering, or a related field.
  • Two or more years of relevant experience in transportation, aerospace, autonomous vehicles, thermal management, HVAC, cooling systems, or a comparable technical environment.
  • Additional experience supporting electric vehicles, fleet operations, or complex vehicle diagnostic systems is beneficial.

Other Requirements

  • Work arrangement: Onsite in Foster City, California.
  • Availability for night and weekend shifts as needed, with advance notice.
  • Occasional travel to support additional operational locations.
  • Must pass a background check and Motor Vehicle Record (MVR) check.
  • W2 employment only.

job.title: Sr. Accountant
job.description:
Sr. Accountant

Overview

A growing organization is seeking a hands-on Sr. Accountant to help stabilize and strengthen its accounting operations following an acquisition. This remote, contract-to-hire opportunity is ideal for an accounting professional who combines strong technical expertise with a proactive, ownership-driven approach.

In this role, you will take primary responsibility for key month-end close activities, complex journal entries, reconciliations, cash management, and multi-entity accounting processes. You will also review work completed by a distributed AP/AR team, provide guidance and training, and help improve accounting procedures, controls, and automation. Approximately 70% of the role will focus on accounting execution, with the remaining time dedicated to review, support, and team development.

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform daily cash and bank reconciliations across multiple entities.
  • Prepare and review complex journal entries related to accruals, prepaid expenses, capitalized software, intercompany transactions, and foreign currency adjustments.

  • Prepare balance sheet reconciliations, analyze variances, review trial balances, and ensure supporting schedules are accurate and complete.
  • Review AP, AR, expense reporting, cash applications, journal entries, reconciliations, and tax workpapers prepared by an offshore accounting team.
  • Provide first-level review, guidance, and training to AP and AR team members.
  • Support revenue recognition, deferred revenue, and management reporting activities.

  • Coordinate audit preparation by gathering documentation and managing audit requests.
  • Develop and maintain accounting procedures, strengthen internal controls, and identify process improvement and automation opportunities.
  • Assist with accounting system implementations, acquisition integration, and other special projects.

Required Skills and Qualifications

  • Solid knowledge of U.S. GAAP and the ability to independently prepare complex journal entries.
  • Experience working in a multi-entity accounting environment.
  • Experience with cash management, treasury operations, payment processing, and bank reconciliations.

  • Ability to work independently, exercise sound accounting judgment, identify discrepancies, and make informed decisions.
  • Strong attention to detail and analytical problem-solving skills.

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Experience in a SaaS, technology, or recurring-revenue business.

A bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field is preferred, along with 5+ years of progressive accounting experience. Candidates with experience supporting multi-entity organizations, acquisition integration, technical accounting activities, and recurring-revenue businesses will be especially well suited for this opportunity.

job.title: Quality Systems Engineer
job.description:
Quality Systems Engineer

Overview

Drive the systems, processes, and continuous improvement initiatives that ensure products and services consistently meet defined standards, specifications, and customer expectations. As a Quality Systems Engineer, you will help develop and sustain a scalable Quality Management System (QMS) across hardware, software, manufacturing, and service operations. Reporting to the Manager, Quality Systems, you will partner closely with Engineering, Manufacturing Operations, Supply Chain, and other cross-functional teams to strengthen quality architecture, improve business processes, support compliance, and promote a culture of operational excellence.

This role offers the opportunity to shape quality processes in a fast-changing environment while contributing to document control, corrective action, audits, process integration, quality reporting, and the evolution of procedures aligned with international quality standards.

Required Skills and Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in an engineering discipline
  • At least 5 years of experience in quality
  • Ability to read and interpret technical prints, including GD&T
  • Experience with document control and revision management in a regulated or standards-driven environment
  • Working knowledge of ISO 9001 and IATF 16949
  • Experience with change control boards and engineering change order (ECO) processes
  • Experience writing procedures, work instructions, process flows, policies, and quality records
  • Experience with project management and process mapping
  • Experience implementing quality processes into ERP, MES, or QMS systems
  • Knowledge of core quality tools, including:
  • FMEA
  • Control Plans
  • 8D
  • PPAP
  • SPC
  • CAPA
  • RCCA
  • Ability to lead root cause analysis and process improvement activities independently
  • Experience planning or conducting internal audits
  • Ability to collect, analyze, and report quality metrics
  • Comfort using AI tools to improve documentation, data analysis, audit preparation, and reporting workflows
  • Strong organizational, analytical, written, and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to collaborate effectively across functions and adapt to a fast-changing, dynamic environment

Nice to Have Skills

  • Lead Auditor certification
  • Prior experience supporting ISO 9001 or IATF 16949 audits
  • Experience with SAP and Jira
  • Background in automotive, software, contract manufacturing, or customer management
  • Experience integrating quality processes with ERP, MES, EQMS, or other business systems
  • Experience developing dashboards and management reports
  • Experience supporting quality processes across both hardware and software environments

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering or a related technical discipline
  • 5 or more years of quality engineering or quality systems experience
  • Experience developing, implementing, and maintaining a Quality Management System
  • Experience in a manufacturing, automotive, software, service, or other standards-driven environment

Key Responsibilities

  • Maintain and continuously improve the Quality Management System
  • Support the implementation and maintenance of ISO 9001 and IATF 16949 requirements
  • Design scalable quality processes that support growth across hardware, software, manufacturing, and service functions
  • Ensure alignment with internal quality policies and applicable external requirements
  • Establish and maintain connections between quality processes and systems such as SAP, EQMS, MES, Jira, and 3DX
  • Manage document control activities, including creation, review, approval, revision control, distribution, retention, obsolescence, and engineering change updates
  • Develop and maintain procedures, work instructions, forms, quality records, control plans, quality plans, inspection criteria, and new product introduction quality deliverables
  • Lead investigations into nonconformances and drive corrective and preventive actions
  • Monitor corrective action effectiveness and support continuous improvement initiatives
  • Plan and conduct internal audits
  • Collect and analyze quality metrics to identify trends and improvement opportunities
  • Prepare quality reports and dashboards for management review
  • Partner with Engineering, Manufacturing Operations, Supply Chain, and other teams to ensure quality requirements are met
  • Standardize and harmonize processes for nonconforming product control, rework, and deviation activities

Other Requirements

  • Work arrangement: Onsite
  • Location: Hayward, CA
  • Engagement duration: 12 months
  • Expected start: ASAP
  • Must be able to work effectively in a cross-functional, fast-paced environment and manage multiple priorities independently

job.title: Fleet Support Engineer
job.description:
Fleet Support Engineer

Overview

Keep an autonomous vehicle fleet operating safely, reliably, and efficiently as a Fleet Support Engineer. In this onsite role, you will serve as the primary technical point of contact for real-time escalations across vehicle subsystems, partnering with technicians, engineering teams, and fleet operations to diagnose complex issues and restore vehicle availability.

You will use first-principles reasoning, fleet data, diagnostic tools, and modern AI tools to identify root causes—not simply replace parts. From reviewing vehicle logs and validating new sensors to developing troubleshooting procedures and preventing recurring issues, your work will directly support vehicle performance and reliability in the field.

Required Skills

  • At least 3 years of hands-on experience in automotive, autonomous vehicles, transportation, or another complex hardware environment
  • Experience troubleshooting across multiple vehicle systems, or equivalent practical experience
  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical, Mechanical, or Computer Engineering, or equivalent practical experience
  • Strong first-principles understanding of vehicle systems and system behavior
  • Ability to safely troubleshoot low- and high-voltage circuits with appropriate training
  • Ability to interpret schematics, electrical diagrams, connector end views, and pinouts
  • Experience with vehicle diagnostics, including fault codes, CAN, or UDS, or the ability to learn these quickly
  • Comfort using modern AI tools to accelerate triage and data analysis while validating conclusions against schematics, data, and physical principles
  • Comfort working with data using Python or SQL, or demonstrated willingness to develop these skills
  • Strong problem-solving skills and a proactive, figure-it-out approach when documentation is incomplete or issues are ambiguous
  • Effective communication and relationship-building skills across technicians, engineering, and real-time operations
  • Reliable onsite attendance during the scheduled shift
  • Ability to pass a background check and Motor Vehicle Record check

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Experience with electric vehicle technology
  • Experience supporting vehicle troubleshooting remotely
  • Knowledge of vehicle systems and diagnostic tools, including UDS
  • Experience with Linux and Python for fleet-level data processing
  • Experience working with software that interfaces with hardware
  • Familiarity with networking, TCP, and socket programming
  • Experience with sensor systems such as LiDAR, radar, or cameras
  • Experience developing diagnostic procedures, troubleshooting guides, or fleet countermeasures

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical, Mechanical, or Computer Engineering preferred
  • Three or more years of hands-on experience troubleshooting complex hardware or vehicle systems preferred
  • Equivalent practical experience demonstrating strong diagnostic judgment, technical breadth, and the ability to learn new vehicle hardware is also considered

Other Requirements

  • Work arrangement: Onsite in Las Vegas, Nevada
  • Schedule: Monday through Friday, 7:00 AM–4:00 PM
  • Availability for overtime as needed, with advance notice
  • Occasional travel within the United States to support other operational locations
  • Ability to work across vehicle subsystems without requiring deep expertise in every system; training on specific hardware will be provided
  • Strong commitment to safe, methodical troubleshooting and accurate technical documentation

job.title: Senior Payroll Administrator
job.description:
Senior Payroll Administrator (Hybrid / Remote Option on Pacific Time)

Location: Palo Alto, CA (Hybrid – ~2-3 days/week) or Remote (Pacific Time)

Company: Confidential Medical Device / Healthcare Technology Company

Department: Finance & Accounting

Employment Type: Full-Time

About the Opportunity

We are partnering with a high-growth, globally backed medical device company headquartered in Palo Alto to find a Senior Payroll Administrator.

Reporting directly to the Assistant Controller, this role sits squarely within the Finance and Accounting organization and owns end-to-end U.S. payroll operations for a dynamic, scaling employee base. This is not just a transactional processing role; it is a critical opportunity for a process-builder to partner with cross-functional teams, drive operational cleanup, implement system best practices, and contribute to an ongoing payroll and compliance modernization journey.

Key Responsibilities

  • End-to-End Payroll Operations: Own and execute bi-weekly, monthly, and special payroll runs for approximately 265+ U.S. employees (including hourly, salaried, and international expatriate populations) across 30+ states.
  • Compliance & Tax Governance: Ensure flawless multi-state tax compliance, manage garnishments, oversee supplemental tax rates, track regulatory updates (including Secure 2.0), and collaborate with external providers to resolve tax notices and multi-jurisdictional registrations.
  • Accounting & General Ledger Integration: Partner closely with accounting to prepare payroll-related journal entries, manage balance sheet account reconciliations, support monthly/quarterly/yearly close cycles, and ensure clean GL mapping within ADP and ERP systems.
  • Audit & Benefit Administration: Lead payroll-related preparation and support for annual audits, including Workers' Compensation, 401(k) plans, and financial audits. Ensure accurate benefit premium calculations and FSA/401(k) funding.
  • Process Improvement & Documentation: Act as a change agent by building out robust standard operating procedures (SOPs), cleaning up historical data, automating manual workflows, and optimizing ADP Workforce Now configurations.
  • Internal Customer Support: Serve as a trusted, communicative resource for employees across the organization, providing clear guidance on payroll timelines, earnings, and policies while maintaining strict discretion over confidential data.

What We’re Looking For

  • Experience: Minimum 7–8+ years of progressive, multi-state payroll processing experience in fast-paced environments (diversity of company types and hands-on operational exposure preferred).
  • Technical Mastery: Advanced, hands-on proficiency with ADP Workforce Now (system setup, troubleshooting, and configuration—not just data entry).
  • Compliance Expertise: Deep understanding of multi-state payroll regulations, overtime, meal penalties, regular rate of pay, supplemental tax rates, and tax compliance.
  • Accounting Acumen: Solid foundational accounting skills with a strong understanding of debits, credits, journal entries, and general ledger reconciliation workflows.
  • The Builder Mindset: A proactive, assertive, and tactful professional who thrives on process improvement, documentation, system cleanup, and cross-functional collaboration.
  • Credentials: Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Business, or HR, a Certified Payroll Professional (CPP) designation, or ADP Workforce Now certifications are highly preferred.
  • Location Flexibility: Candidates within 60 miles of Palo Alto are expected to work a hybrid schedule (~2–3 days/week onsite). Strong remote candidates based on Pacific Time outside of the Bay Area will also be considered.

What’s in It for You?

  • Competitive Compensation: Base salary range of $110,000 – $130,000+ (depending on experience and location) plus strong comprehensive benefits.
  • Visibility & Impact: A high-visibility role within a stable, globally backed organization experiencing major commercial growth and roadmap milestones.
  • Professional Growth: Opportunity to expand scope (including potential oversight of T&E functions) and be a foundational pillar in modernizing the company's financial infrastructure.



DeWinter Group and Maris Consulting is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. We post pay scales which are based on our client pay ranges. DeWinter, Maris, and our clients have the right to modify the requirements of the role which can impact the pay ranges posted.

job.title: Frontend Developer - Design Systems
job.description:
Frontend Developer – Design Systems

Overview

Build the foundation behind a suite of modern applications as a Frontend Developer – Design Systems. This role is ideal for a detail-oriented frontend engineer who cares deeply about how interfaces look, feel, and perform—from precise spacing and interaction states to motion, accessibility, responsive behavior, and pixel-perfect implementation.

You’ll build and maintain React components ranging from foundational primitives to complex composite patterns, translating detailed Figma designs into production-ready code. You’ll partner closely with designers and engineers, provide thoughtful technical feedback, strengthen component testing and documentation, and help establish the guardrails that make AI-assisted development reliable and scalable. Because the design system includes 3D experiences, experience with Three.js is highly valued.

What You’ll Do

  • Build and maintain reusable React components for a shared design system.
  • Translate detailed Figma specifications into accurate, responsive implementations.
  • Implement component states, transitions, animations, light and dark modes, and responsive behavior.
  • Review designs before implementation, identify potential issues, and recommend solutions that protect the design vision.
  • Contribute to Storybook by writing stories, maintaining documentation, and improving usability for consuming engineers.
  • Write component tests with Vitest and Testing Library.
  • Develop end-to-end and visual regression coverage with Playwright as part of CI workflows.
  • Use AI coding tools extensively while reviewing and refining every line of generated code.
  • Help develop prompts, rules, linting, type constraints, and review workflows that keep AI-generated code aligned with engineering standards.
  • Ensure components use design tokens consistently rather than hardcoded values.
  • Implement CSS animations, transitions, keyframes, and WebGL experiences where appropriate.
  • Collaborate daily with designers and engineers, participate in code reviews, and shepherd focused pull requests through completion.
  • Maintain a high standard of visual and technical quality across the design system.

Required Skills and Qualifications

  • At least 4 years of frontend development experience.
  • Significant experience working on a component library or design system.
  • Deep expertise with JavaScript and React, including:
  • Composition patterns
  • React hooks
  • Component performance
  • Reusable component API design
  • Advanced CSS skills, including animations, transitions, responsive design, and interaction states.
  • Strong ability to implement highly detailed designs from Figma.
  • Experience reviewing design specifications, inspecting values, and identifying design intent.
  • Hands-on experience with software testing, including:
  • Vitest
  • Testing Library
  • Playwright
  • End-to-end and visual regression testing
  • Solid understanding of CI pipelines.
  • Experience with design tokens and approaches that support a consistent source of truth across platforms.
  • Extensive experience using AI coding tools, with the judgment to evaluate and correct their output.
  • Strong attention to detail and a commitment to polished, pixel-accurate interfaces.
  • Ability to communicate technical opinions clearly, collaborate effectively, and thoughtfully challenge designs or implementation approaches when appropriate.
  • Experience partnering with designers and engineers throughout the development lifecycle.

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Experience with Three.js, React Three Fiber, or similar React/Three.js technologies.
  • Working knowledge of MUI, including theming, overrides, and extensions.
  • Experience creating custom tooling around AI agents, including MCP servers, Skills, custom linting, or code generation.
  • Experience with WebGL.
  • Experience with code generation.
  • Exposure to iOS or Android design systems and development workflows.
  • Experience building or maintaining AI-assisted development workflows.

Preferred Education and Experience

  • A minimum of 4 years of professional frontend development experience is preferred.
  • Experience delivering and supporting production-grade design systems or component libraries is strongly preferred.
  • Formal educational requirements were not specified for this position.

Other Requirements

  • Work arrangement: Hybrid, with onsite work required Monday through Wednesday in Foster City, California.
  • Engagement: W2 only.
  • Contract duration: 6 months.
  • Start date: As soon as possible.
  • The role requires close collaboration with design and engineering partners and a strong commitment to precise, high-quality implementation.

job.title: Supplier Quality Engineer – Sensors
job.description:

job.title: Manufacturing Data Engineer
job.description:

Build the data foundation powering manufacturing intelligence in this hands-on contract opportunity. As a Manufacturing Data Engineer, you will design, develop, and maintain reliable data pipelines and models that bring together manufacturing data from on-premises databases, SAP MES, SAP HANA, test and diagnostic systems, and related sources. You will transform this data into trusted lakehouse tables that support manufacturing KPIs, dashboards, analytics, and AI use cases.

Approximately 80% of the role will focus on hands-on data engineering, with the remaining time dedicated to keeping pipelines deployable, observable, governed, and cost efficient. You will collaborate closely with data engineering, data analytics, manufacturing operations, infrastructure, and Databricks platform teams while supporting the migration of existing Redshift models and pipelines to Databricks.

Required Skills

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
  • 6+ years of professional data engineering experience
  • Strong SQL and Python skills, including PySpark
  • Hands-on production experience with Databricks, including:
  • Delta Lake
  • Unity Catalog permissions and governance
  • Databricks Workflows or jobs
  • Spark performance tuning
  • Production experience with dbt, including incremental models and testing
  • Strong understanding of:
  • Dimensional data modeling
  • Medallion architecture
  • Change data capture (CDC)
  • Incremental data loading
  • Experience building batch and streaming ingestion pipelines using technologies such as Auto Loader, Lakeflow Declarative Pipelines, Lakeflow Connect, or Structured Streaming
  • Experience with incremental models, MERGE and upsert patterns, SCD Type 2, and late or out-of-order records
  • Experience deploying data code through Git-based workflows and CI/CD, such as GitHub Actions or Databricks Asset Bundles
  • Working knowledge of AWS data services, including S3, IAM, DMS, or Kinesis
  • Experience with infrastructure as code, such as Terraform
  • Ability to process large and semi-structured datasets, including JSON test payloads
  • Experience with data quality, pipeline monitoring, freshness SLAs, and alerting
  • Strong communication and documentation skills, with the ability to partner with technical teams, analysts, and manufacturing stakeholders

Nice to Have Skills

  • Databricks Certified Data Engineer Associate or Professional certification
  • AWS certification, such as Solutions Architect Associate
  • Experience preparing data for Databricks AI/BI dashboards, Genie, machine learning, or LLM use cases
  • Background working with manufacturing or industrial data, including quality, yield, traceability, station results, work orders, or MES
  • Experience migrating Redshift models and pipelines to Databricks
  • Familiarity with SAP MES, SAP HANA, AWS DMS, SAP SLT, Airflow, or Kinesis
  • Understanding of data governance and compliance as they relate to data pipelines
  • Experience managing Unity Catalog catalogs, schemas, volumes, grants, service principals, secret scopes, and OAuth machine-to-machine authentication
  • Experience monitoring cloud data platform usage, job health, and compute costs

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience
  • 6+ years of data engineering experience in production environments
  • Experience designing and supporting enterprise-scale data platforms, lakehouses, and analytics systems
  • Experience working with manufacturing, operational, or industrial data is preferred

Other Requirements

  • Contract duration: 12 months
  • Work arrangement: Fully onsite in Foster City, California
  • W2 engagement only
  • Ability to support production data pipelines, operational monitoring, incident response, and root cause analysis
  • Ability to document pipelines, data lineage, data contracts, table definitions, runbooks, and operational procedures
  • Ability to collaborate across data engineering, analytics, manufacturing operations, infrastructure, and platform teams

Lead the mechanical design and development of automotive headrest systems from concept through shipment. In this role, you will help advance complete seating systems by developing robust, manufacturable designs and supporting the in-house design and analysis process. You will collaborate closely with Industrial Design, Vehicle Engineering, Purchasing, Reliability, Packaging, Quality, Manufacturing, and Safety teams to resolve complex design challenges and deliver solutions that meet demanding safety, comfort, performance, and production requirements.

This role is well suited for an accomplished automotive seating engineer with deep expertise in headrest assemblies, seating structures, packaging, kinematics, and system-level development.

Required Skills and Qualifications

  • FMVSS safety requirements
  • Design considerations affecting HIC scores
  • IIHS requirements
  • Comfort requirements
  • Modal and NVH requirements
  • Operational strength requirements
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and general mechanical engineering analysis skills.

  • Significant 3D CAD experience, including proficiency with CATIA V6.
  • Experience with seat system packaging, kinematics, and modeling.
  • Demonstrated ability to design metallic and composite parts.
  • Working knowledge of finite element analysis theory and general mechanical engineering analysis.
  • Experience with:
  • Design for Manufacturability (DFM)
  • Design for Assembly (DFA)
  • Statistical tolerance analysis
  • Functional dimensioning
  • Geometric tolerancing
  • Preparing and checking 2D drawings
  • Ability to work effectively in a team environment and independently drive design issues to closure.
  • Flexibility and comfort working in a fast-paced environment subject to change.

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Experience developing mechanical design and analysis capabilities in-house.
  • Broad experience spanning headrest assemblies, seating structures, and complete seat systems.
  • Experience creating and executing component or system test and validation plans.
  • Experience collaborating across design, engineering, manufacturing, quality, purchasing, reliability, packaging, and safety functions.
  • Experience documenting design trade-offs, technical decisions, and program status.

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Sandboxing
  • Firewalls and next-generation firewalls (NGFWs)
  • Web application firewalls (WAF)
  • Bot management and rate limiting
  • SSL/IPsec and SSL/TLS VPN appliances and services
  • Hands-on experience configuring, deploying, migrating, or troubleshooting security technologies in production environments.
  • Experience integrating identity providers with enterprise applications, including:
  • SSO using SAML and OIDC
  • SCIM user and group provisioning and deprovisioning
  • Group and attribute mapping
  • Identity provider handshake troubleshooting
  • Working knowledge of modern identity technologies, including LDAP/Active Directory, MFA, FIDO2, and the role of the identity provider.
  • Hands-on experience with Microsoft Entra ID, Okta, or Ping.
  • In-depth DNS experience, including:
  • DNS filtering
  • DoH and DoT
  • Conditional forwarding and split-DNS
  • Internal-zone resolution
  • Local domain fallback
  • Experience with software distribution and deployment across Windows, macOS, and Linux environments.
  • Windows and Linux server administration experience.
  • Client-endpoint troubleshooting across Windows, macOS, and Linux.
  • Ability to debug network connectivity issues using standard troubleshooting tools, including packet capture and DNS/HTTP tracing.
  • Strong project management skills, including the ability to meet deadlines and prioritize competing demands.
  • Professional fluency in English.

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Fluency in Spanish or Portuguese.
  • Automation and infrastructure-as-code experience with:
  • Terraform, preferably with the Cloudflare provider
  • REST APIs
  • Python or Bash scripting
  • Git
  • CI/CD
  • Policy-as-code
  • Cloud networking experience with AWS, Azure, or GCP, including:
  • VPC/VNet
  • Security Groups, NSGs, and NACLs
  • Cloud-native DNS resolvers
  • Cloud IAM
  • Connector deployment in IaaS environments
  • SASE on-ramp networking experience, including IPsec/GRE tunnels, BGP, Anycast, network segmentation, SD-WAN, MPLS, or WAN optimization.
  • MDM software distribution experience with Intune or Jamf.
  • Experience with Active Directory, Group Policy, Entra ID, or Intune.
  • Observability experience, including Logpush, SIEM integrations, or Digital Experience Monitoring (DEX).
  • Familiarity with SIEM platforms such as Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel, Elastic, or Chronicle.
  • Knowledge of NIST Zero Trust Architecture and compliance frameworks such as GDPR, DORA, NIS2, ISO 27001, PCI DSS, HIPAA, SOC 2, or FedRAMP.
  • Familiarity with AI security and shadow-AI governance, including AI-tool discovery, gating, and AI Gateway concepts.

Preferred Education and Experience

  • 3+ years of relevant experience in technical implementation, customer onboarding, security engineering, security operations, or a comparable technical field.
  • Demonstrated production experience configuring, deploying, migrating, and troubleshooting enterprise security, networking, identity, endpoint, or cloud technologies.
  • A specific educational background was not provided for this position; equivalent hands-on technical experience is relevant.

Other Requirements

  • Work arrangement: Fully remote.
  • Time zone: Candidates must be able to work within Central Standard Time (CST).
  • Engagement type: W2 only.
  • Contract duration: 6 months.
  • Start date: As soon as possible.
  • English is required for day-to-day work. Spanish or Portuguese fluency is a strong advantage.
  • Certifications such as CISSP, CCSP, SC-300, AZ-500, AWS Security Specialty, CCNP, CCIE, CompTIA, or equivalent are strong advantages. Forensic certifications, including GCFA, GCFE, GCIA, or GCIH, are welcome but not central to the role.

job.title: Senior NetSuite Analyst
job.description:
Senior NetSuite Analyst

Overview

Step into a high-impact role supporting a critical NetSuite environment at a time when continuity, technical expertise, and business partnership matter most. The Senior NetSuite Analyst will serve as the primary point of contact for business stakeholders, helping prioritize, design, troubleshoot, and implement solutions across the Procurement and Order-to-Cash ecosystem.

This role is ideal for a hands-on NetSuite professional who combines strong technical capabilities with accounting knowledge and a consulting mindset. You will support an established NetSuite and Advanced Revenue Management (ARM) environment—not a new ERP implementation—while maintaining existing functionality, resolving complex issues, optimizing processes, and delivering enhancements and integrations. The position will collaborate closely with Finance, Accounting, Salesforce, and other business teams, serving as a project manager, business analyst, functional lead, and implementation resource for small- to medium-sized initiatives.

Required Skills

  • 4–6 years of relevant NetSuite experience, including hands-on experience with the Advanced Revenue Management (ARM) module.
  • NetSuite Certified Administrator certification or equivalent experience of 2–4 years.
  • Experience troubleshooting deferred revenue schedules and revenue recognition issues.
  • Experience supporting Order-to-Cash processes, including order processing, invoicing, tax calculations, and revenue recognition.
  • Experience working with NetSuite in an integrated Salesforce environment.
  • Hands-on NetSuite system configuration experience.
  • Demonstrated ability to create meaningful, accurate, and low-maintenance reports and saved searches.
  • Strong understanding of accounting and Finance and Accounting business processes.
  • Strong data analysis, problem-solving, and process-analysis skills.
  • Ability to diagram business processes and system workflows for different audiences.
  • Ability to translate business requirements into practical, scalable technology solutions.
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
  • Ability to work autonomously while collaborating effectively within a team.
  • Adaptability and willingness to learn and support a customized technology environment.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-moving environment.
  • A problem-solving mindset focused on building sustainable, long-term solutions while addressing immediate business needs.

Nice to Have Skills

  • Experience with Salesforce.com or a comparable CRM platform.
  • Experience with Salesforce CPQ, including product bundling and flexible pricing.
  • Experience with Avalara, Xactly, Concur, or AvidXchange.
  • Experience supporting invoice PDF generation and presentation solutions, including Conga.
  • Experience as a customer-facing consultant.
  • Experience acting as a project manager for small- to medium-sized technology projects.
  • Experience managing external consultants and implementation partners.
  • Ability to use SQL tools for research, requirements mapping, data analysis, and validation.
  • Experience supporting monthly and quarterly financial close processes.
  • Experience managing stakeholder backlogs, case queues, and system issue resolution.
  • Experience with NetSuite solution architecture and complex technical issue resolution.

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related discipline.
  • Equivalent professional experience may be considered in place of a degree.
  • Senior-level experience administering, configuring, and optimizing NetSuite in an integrated business applications environment.
  • Experience supporting Finance and Accounting teams with operational systems, reporting, close processes, and audit readiness.
  • Experience gathering requirements, evaluating current-state processes, researching solution options, and managing implementation deliverables.

Other Requirements

  • Initial contract term of approximately three months, with potential to extend to six months or longer based on business and audit needs.
  • Contract-to-hire potential may be available; candidates who prefer to remain contractors are also welcome.
  • Full-time schedule of approximately 40 hours per week.
  • Hybrid position based in Waltham, MA, with onsite work required three days per week.
  • Up to 10% travel may be required.
  • Availability to begin as soon as possible is strongly preferred.
  • Must be comfortable supporting an established NetSuite environment, ongoing integrations, business-critical Finance and Accounting operations, and time-sensitive audit-related priorities.
  • Must be flexible, consultative, confident recommending best practices, and comfortable operating in a fast-moving, constantly evolving environment.

job.title: Senior Accounting Manager
job.description:
Senior Accounting Manager

Overview

Join a rapidly growing, globally operating manufacturing organization as a hands-on Senior Accounting Manager and trusted partner to the Controller. This individual-contributor role is ideal for an accounting professional who thrives in an evolving environment, brings strong manufacturing and global consolidation experience, and is ready to build structure, strengthen processes, and deliver accurate financial reporting across multiple entities.

You will own key accounting activities from journal entries and reconciliations through close, consolidation, audit support, and process improvement. Success in this role requires sound judgment, attention to detail, a willingness to investigate complex issues, and the confidence to ask questions and push back when needed.

Required Skills and Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
  • 5–7 years of progressive accounting experience within the manufacturing industry.
  • Hands-on experience with general ledger accounting and month-end financial close.
  • Experience with global, multi-entity consolidations involving multiple currencies.
  • Knowledge of intercompany accounting, eliminations, foreign currency remeasurement and translation, and cumulative translation adjustments.
  • Strong working knowledge of U.S. GAAP and the ability to apply accounting principles to operational transactions and financial reporting.
  • Practical understanding of manufacturing accounting, including:
  • Inventory valuation
  • Cost accounting concepts
  • Standard costs and manufacturing variances
  • Overhead allocation
  • Excess and obsolete inventory reserves
  • Work in process and finished goods
  • Inventory cutoff and goods received not invoiced
  • Experience with balance sheet reconciliations, accruals, fixed assets, construction in progress, leases, prepaids, and other core accounting areas.
  • Proficiency with NetSuite; the ability to prepare entries, extract financial data, reconcile subledgers, and develop reports or saved searches.
  • Advanced Excel skills, including pivot tables, lookup functions, and analysis of large datasets.
  • Ability to independently research accounting issues, document conclusions, investigate discrepancies, and recommend resolutions.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage competing deadlines and deliver accurate, review-ready work.
  • Clear written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with international finance teams and cross-functional partners across time zones.
  • Willingness to work in an unstructured, fast-changing environment and take on varied responsibilities.

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • NetSuite OneWorld experience.
  • Experience supporting acquisition integration and onboarding new legal entities.
  • Familiarity with Carta and Workday payroll systems.
  • Experience with purchase accounting, opening balance sheet reconciliations, chart of accounts mapping, and subsidiary reporting packages.
  • Experience supporting audits, SOX-readiness initiatives, control remediation, or internal-control improvements.
  • Experience developing accounting procedures, improving documentation, and scaling close and reporting processes.
  • Exposure to transfer-pricing-related entries, intercompany funding, and treasury activities.
  • Interest in learning and applying AI tools to improve accounting efficiency and reporting.

Preferred Education and Experience

The preferred candidate will hold a bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related discipline and bring 5–7 years of progressive accounting experience in manufacturing, including experience with global consolidations, multiple legal entities, intercompany accounting, inventory, cost accounting, and month-end close.

Experience working in a rapidly changing or acquisition-driven organization is highly beneficial. This role is designed for an experienced individual contributor who can operate independently while partnering closely with accounting leadership, operations, supply chain, tax, treasury, and international finance teams.

Other Requirements

  • This is a contract-to-hire, onsite role based in San Jose, California.
  • Candidates must be local to the Bay Area and able to commute to the San Jose office near the Great America/Santa Clara border.
  • The position requires at least four days per week in the office, Monday through Thursday, during the first 90 days to support onboarding and integration.
  • This is an individual-contributor position with no direct reports.
  • Candidates must be thorough, proactive, comfortable challenging assumptions, and willing to speak up when accounting issues or process risks require attention.

job.title: Senior Cash Applications Specialist
job.description:
Senior Cash Applications Specialist

Overview

Join a collaborative Finance team as a Senior Cash Applications Specialist responsible for ensuring the accurate and timely application of client payments and supporting the integrity of financial records. This role will play an important part in billing, collections, reconciliations, and financial close activities while partnering with billing professionals, attorneys, clients, and internal stakeholders across multiple offices.

The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, proactive, and confident taking ownership of complex cash application issues. This is an opportunity to serve as a subject matter resource, improve processes, and mentor junior team members in a dynamic professional services environment.

Required Skills

  • At least 3 years of experience owning cash application or accounts receivable processes; 5 years preferred
  • Experience supporting daily cash application activities as well as month-end, quarter-end, and year-end close processes
  • Ability to accurately apply incoming payments, including checks, wires, ACH payments, and credit cards
  • Experience researching and resolving unapplied or misapplied payments
  • Proficiency with billing software such as Elite 3E, Aderant, or a similar system
  • Experience with e-billing platforms
  • Intermediate Microsoft Excel skills and proficiency with Microsoft Office
  • Understanding of billing procedures, fee arrangements, and client-specific billing guidelines
  • Strong attention to detail, organization, follow-through, and time management
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to interact effectively with legal staff, clients, management, and support personnel
  • Strong sense of accountability with a proactive approach to problem-solving
  • Ability to collaborate effectively across teams and offices

Nice to Have Skills

  • Experience in a law firm or professional services environment
  • Familiarity with legal billing and client trust account transactions
  • Experience reconciling trust account activity in accordance with applicable policies and standards
  • Experience identifying and implementing process improvements
  • Previous experience mentoring or serving as a subject matter expert for junior team members
  • Experience working in a multi-office environment

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree preferred
  • Five or more years of cash application experience preferred
  • Experience with Elite 3E, Aderant, or comparable legal billing systems preferred
  • Legal industry experience preferred

Other Requirements

  • Hybrid schedule with two remote days and three in-office days per week
  • Position is based in either New York City or Boston
  • Standard schedule is Monday through Friday, 9:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., with a one-hour lunch
  • Business-casual work environment
  • Successful completion of a background check and drug screen is required before starting
  • Occasional collaboration with colleagues across multiple offices is required

job.title: AP Specialist
job.description:
AP Specialist — Fully Remote Contract Opportunity

Overview

Join a small, collaborative Accounts Payable team supporting a fast-paced technology organization. As an AP Specialist, you’ll take ownership of high-volume, full-cycle accounts payable activities while helping ensure invoices are processed accurately, approvals move efficiently, and vendor accounts remain reconciled. This role is ideal for a detail-oriented accounting professional who can work independently, communicate clearly in a virtual environment, and quickly adapt to new systems and processes.

Required Skills

  • Strong full-cycle accounts payable experience
  • High-volume invoice processing experience, including approximately 800+ invoices per month
  • Experience entering invoices, requesting approvals, and resolving discrepancies
  • Hands-on experience with 2-way and 3-way matching in NetSuite
  • Experience performing vendor statement reconciliations
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including VLOOKUPs and PivotTables
  • Experience with expense processing in Concur
  • Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy
  • Ability to learn systems, processes, and data-entry requirements quickly with minimal ramp-up
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to document processes and communicate effectively through virtual meetings and training
  • Strong workload management and self-management skills
  • Flexibility to pivot, take initiative, and support the team where needed

Nice to Have Skills

  • Experience working on a small Accounts Payable team
  • Previous experience in a fully remote accounting role
  • Experience taking ownership of assigned vendor relationships
  • Experience supporting process improvements or documenting AP procedures
  • Experience in a fast-paced technology or corporate environment

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Several years of progressive, full-cycle accounts payable experience preferred
  • Experience with NetSuite and Concur preferred
  • Formal educational requirements were not specified for this opportunity

Other Requirements

  • Work arrangement: Fully remote
  • Schedule: Monday through Friday, approximately 6–8 hours per day, with the schedule arranged between 8:00 a.m. and 5:00 p.m. Pacific Time
  • Duration: Anticipated 2–6+ months, with the possibility of extension
  • Start: ASAP
  • Must be comfortable working independently in a remote environment and participating in virtual meetings and training
  • Must be able to manage a high-volume workload while maintaining accuracy and meeting deadlines

job.title: Project Manager - Real Estate Project Design & Delivery
job.description:
Project Manager – Real Estate Project Design & Delivery

Location: Hybrid — San Francisco, CA
Duration: 6 months
Employment Type: W2 only
Start Date: ASAP

Overview

Lead the delivery of multiple workplace capital construction projects as the essential link between business stakeholders, internal partner teams, and the external professionals responsible for design and construction. This role offers the opportunity to shape projects from early planning through handover, applying technical judgment, strategic thinking, and strong project leadership to ensure workplace environments are delivered on time, within budget, and ready for business operations.

As an owner-side project representative and integrator, you will translate business and operational needs into clear project briefs, coordinate complex third-party teams, establish effective project controls, and provide concise recommendations to executive and non-technical audiences. Success in this role requires the ability to anticipate downstream impacts, identify risks early, and balance detailed execution with broader project objectives.

Responsibilities

  • Represent internal business users and partner functions throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Partner with Workplace Services, Security, IT, AV, Finance, Procurement, and Legal to incorporate requirements, approvals, budgets, and schedules into project plans.
  • Translate business and operational needs into functional program briefs and scopes of work.
  • Coordinate construction project managers, architects, MEP engineers, code consultants, general contractors, and other third-party professionals.
  • Establish ownership of deliverables, communication processes, and escalation pathways.
  • Maintain project controls for scope, schedule, budget, procurement, compliance, risk, and change management.
  • Coordinate stakeholder design and functional program reviews.
  • Document approvals and decisions affecting procurement and construction milestones.
  • Monitor progress against approved project plans and schedules.
  • Identify emerging risks, assess root causes, and recommend mitigation strategies.
  • Represent project status and decision points at governance meetings.
  • Prepare concise executive summaries covering project progress, significance, risks, impacts, and required actions.
  • Coordinate project handover and first day of business readiness.
  • Confirm completion of as-built documentation, training, warranty, and maintenance information.

Required Skills and Qualifications

  • 7+ years of relevant experience in project or program management, construction, architecture, engineering, corporate real estate, or a related field.
  • Demonstrated experience delivering complex workplace or capital projects.
  • Working knowledge of commercial office construction processes, including:
  • Design coordination
  • Construction documentation
  • Permitting
  • Scheduling
  • Budgeting
  • Procurement
  • Change management
  • Commissioning
  • Project handover
  • Experience translating diverse stakeholder needs into clear requirements, decisions, and execution plans.
  • Ability to navigate competing priorities while maintaining focus on project objectives.
  • Familiarity with project controls and financial management, including budget development, cash-flow forecasting, change control, risk management, and approval tracking.
  • Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills.
  • Ability to communicate complex technical project information clearly and concisely to non-technical audiences.
  • Strong strategic judgment and the ability to operate autonomously in a fast-moving environment.
  • Ability to balance attention to detail with broader project goals and adapt as project needs evolve.

Nice-to-Have Skills and Experience

  • Experience delivering corporate workplace projects within a technology or other high-growth, matrixed organization.
  • Experience integrating technical workplace requirements, including IT, AV, security, building systems, or other specialist scopes, into construction delivery.
  • Experience representing an occupier or owner.
  • Experience managing external consultants, project managers, landlords, vendors, or general contractors.
  • Project management, construction management, or sustainability credentials such as PMP, CCM, or LEED.

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in design, construction management, architecture, engineering, real estate, or a related field.
  • Equivalent practical experience may be considered.
  • At least 7 years of relevant experience supporting the delivery of complex workplace or capital projects.

Other Requirements

  • This is a hybrid role based in San Francisco, CA.
  • Candidates must be able to work on a W2 basis.
  • Ability to coordinate effectively with internal stakeholders and third-party project teams throughout design, construction, commissioning, and handover.

job.title: Assistant Project Manager - Real Estate Project Design & Delivery
job.description:
Assistant Project Manager – Real Estate Project Design & Delivery

Overview

Support the delivery of multiple workplace construction projects in a fast-paced, collaborative environment. As an Assistant Project Manager, you’ll partner with Project Managers, third-party project teams, and internal Real Estate, Workplace, Finance, and Procurement stakeholders to keep project design, construction, budget, schedule, procurement, and approval information complete and current.

This role is ideal for a highly organized project professional who brings strong process discipline, sound judgment, and the ability to identify issues before they affect project commitments, payments, or delivery milestones. You’ll contribute to projects from design coordination through construction, handover, and first-day business readiness while helping strengthen project delivery processes and reporting standards across global projects.

Required Skills

  • 3–5 years of relevant experience in project management, program management, project coordination, project controls, construction, architecture, engineering, corporate real estate, or a related field.
  • Experience supporting the delivery of complex workplace or capital projects.
  • Familiarity with commercial office construction processes, including:
  • Design coordination
  • Construction documentation
  • Permitting
  • Scheduling
  • Budgeting
  • Procurement
  • Project handover
  • Knowledge of project controls and financial processes, including budget development, cash-flow forecasting, change control, risk management, and approval tracking.
  • Strong organizational skills and exceptional attention to detail.
  • Ability to distinguish routine project updates from issues requiring timely escalation.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to present project data concisely to internal stakeholders.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with Project Managers, third-party project teams, Finance, Procurement, and other internal partners.
  • Ability to track and maintain accurate information related to scopes of work, contract approvals, purchase orders, change requests, budgets, schedules, and procurement milestones.

Nice to Have Skills

  • Experience delivering corporate workplace projects in a technology or other high-growth, matrixed organization.
  • Experience representing an occupier or owner.
  • Experience managing external consultants, project managers, landlords, vendors, or general contractors.
  • Familiarity with workplace design guidelines and technical IT/AV and Security standards.
  • Experience improving project reporting templates, trackers, and delivery processes across multiple projects.
  • Experience supporting FF&E, minor works, signage, punch lists, and first-day business readiness activities.

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in design, construction management, architecture, engineering, real estate, or a related field.
  • Equivalent practical experience may be considered.
  • 3–5 years of experience in project management, project coordination, project controls, construction, architecture, engineering, corporate real estate, or a related discipline.

Other Requirements

  • This is a hybrid position based in San Francisco, California.
  • W2 employment only.
  • Ability to support multiple projects and coordinate with internal and external project teams.
  • Ability to track approval progress and flag incomplete documentation, stalled approvals, and process exceptions before they delay commitments or payments.
  • Ability to support project handover and first-day business readiness preparations with project teams and internal partners.

job.title: Production Designer
job.description:
Production Designer

Overview

Bring bold ideas to life as a hands-on Production Designer supporting brand, digital, print, presentation, and event-related initiatives. This role is ideal for a detail-oriented creative thinker who thrives at the intersection of design and organization. You’ll transform concepts into polished, production-ready assets, develop scalable design resources, and collaborate with cross-functional teams to bring a new brand to life in innovative ways.

Required Skills

  • 5+ years of experience in a creative agency or in-house design studio
  • Bachelor’s degree in Graphic Design, Visual Design, or a related field
  • Strong portfolio demonstrating:
  • Design production expertise
  • Presentation design
  • Typography and layout design
  • Conceptual thinking
  • Large-scale asset production
  • Advanced proficiency in Figma
  • Advanced proficiency in Adobe Creative Cloud, including:
  • InDesign
  • Illustrator
  • Photoshop
  • Advanced proficiency in presentation software, including:
  • Google Slides
  • Keynote
  • PowerPoint
  • Experience developing design systems, toolkits, templates, and production-ready content
  • Strong understanding of typography, layout, balance, and proportion
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills
  • Exceptional attention to detail and a quality-driven approach
  • Ability to prioritize multiple tasks, work efficiently, and respond quickly to feedback
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to troubleshoot design files and content challenges

Nice to Have Skills

  • Experience working across digital, UI, web, and print design
  • Experience creating marketing materials, including email headers and other digital assets
  • Experience designing event print assets and reviewing production files and samples
  • Familiarity with developing mockups, icons, color systems, and other design components
  • Experience conducting design audits across extensive asset libraries
  • Interest in new technology and emerging design tools
  • Experience supporting cross-functional teams in a fast-paced environment

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Graphic Design, Visual Design, or a related discipline
  • 5+ years of professional experience in a creative agency, in-house design studio, or comparable environment
  • A robust portfolio showcasing design production, presentation design, digital and print work, typography, layout, and conceptual design

Other Requirements

  • Work arrangement: Hybrid
  • Location: Foster City, California
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams
  • Ability to manage and maintain individual files as well as large design libraries
  • Ability to implement feedback swiftly and accurately
  • Expected to support presentation decks, event assets, marketing materials, design resources, toolkits, templates, and production-ready content
  • Engagement: 6-month assignment
  • Work authorization arrangement: W-2 only

job.title: Treasury Contractor
job.description:
Treasury Contractor

Overview

Join a high-growth SaaS organization as a hands-on Treasury Contractor supporting global treasury operations across more than 15 countries. This interim role will help establish and strengthen the company’s internal treasury function, with immediate ownership of cash forecasting, liquidity management, bank account administration, and debt covenant compliance.

Reporting to the VP of Corporate Controllership, you will work directly in Excel and banking systems to maintain accurate forecasts, monitor cash positions, and prepare treasury reporting. This is an opportunity for an experienced treasury professional to build scalable processes, improve global cash management, strengthen banking relationships, and help shape treasury operations across multiple currencies and jurisdictions.

Required Skills

  • 7–10 years of progressive treasury experience, preferably within the technology, SaaS, or financial services industry
  • Hands-on experience with global cash management, liquidity forecasting, and multi-currency operations
  • Experience managing banking relationships across multiple entities and jurisdictions
  • Strong financial modeling and advanced Excel skills
  • Experience with bank account administration and treasury reporting
  • Working knowledge of foreign exchange risk management and hedging instruments
  • Familiarity with debt covenant compliance and related reporting
  • Understanding of SOX controls within treasury operations
  • Experience working with treasury management systems and banking platforms
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with Accounting, FP&A, Payroll, Legal, auditors, banking partners, and executive leadership
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to work effectively across time zones
  • Ability to operate independently as a hands-on individual contributor in a developing function
  • SaaS or high-growth startup experience is required

Nice to Have Skills

  • Experience building or significantly expanding a treasury function at a high-growth company
  • Experience with ASC 815 hedge accounting
  • Exposure to emerging-market treasury operations and ARS-related activity
  • Experience with cash pooling, intercompany funding, and working capital management
  • Experience supporting IPO readiness or public company audits
  • Experience with short-term investment strategy and liquidity planning
  • Experience supporting capitalization events, tender offers, or equity-related transactions
  • Certified Treasury Professional (CTP) designation
  • CPA or equivalent professional certification

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, or a related field preferred
  • 7–10 years of progressive treasury experience
  • Background in a global, multi-entity, multi-currency environment
  • Experience establishing treasury processes, controls, reporting, and infrastructure from the ground up

Key Responsibilities

Cash Management and Liquidity

  • Build and manage global cash management infrastructure across multiple operating entities and banking partners
  • Develop daily, weekly, and monthly cash flow forecasts
  • Deliver liquidity analysis and reporting to senior finance leadership
  • Establish cash pooling, intercompany funding, and working capital management processes
  • Support short-term investment strategy in coordination with external advisors
  • Monitor global cash balances and identify liquidity needs and opportunities

Banking and Financial Institution Relationships

  • Serve as a primary point of contact for global banking relationships
  • Evaluate and optimize the banking structure as the organization expands
  • Support bank account openings across new jurisdictions
  • Manage banking services and relationships in partnership with internal stakeholders
  • Partner with Payroll and Accounts Payable to support timely funding for international payroll and vendor payments

Cross-Functional Partnership and Compliance

  • Partner with Payroll on compliant funding across multiple international locations
  • Collaborate with Legal and Accounting on capitalization events, tender offers, and equity-related transactions
  • Support treasury disclosures, audit requests, and covenant reporting
  • Provide FP&A with cash flow forecasting inputs and capital allocation analysis
  • Develop and maintain treasury policies, procedures, controls, and reporting practices
  • Help establish foreign exchange risk management and liquidity reporting processes

Other Requirements

  • Fully remote work is permitted; candidates in the Bay Area are preferred
  • This is a hands-on individual contributor position and is not a people-management role
  • Initial contract duration is expected to be 3–4 months, with potential for extension and possible conversion to a permanent position
  • Ability to work effectively across multiple time zones and international entities
  • Must be comfortable working directly in Excel, banking systems, and other treasury-related platforms
  • Must be able to manage confidential financial information with discretion and accuracy

job.title: Senior Technical Program Manager - Milestone Execution
job.description:
Senior Technical Program Manager – Milestone Execution

Overview

Lead complex, cross-functional product and service milestones that advance the development and launch of innovative mobility solutions. As a Senior Technical Program Manager, you will partner with leaders across vehicle development, systems engineering, software, manufacturing, fleet operations, and business functions to drive milestone execution from strategy through delivery.

You will translate technical and organizational complexity into clear actions, measurable outcomes, timely decisions, and effective execution. This role is ideal for a collaborative program leader who thrives in fast-paced environments, can influence stakeholders across disciplines, and brings strong judgment to product launches, validation, testing, and operational readiness.

Required Skills

  • Lead execution of major product or service milestones, including milestone test strategy and feature lock activities.
  • Define key performance indicators (KPIs) and milestone success metrics that align progress with business goals.
  • Drive stakeholder alignment and executive buy-in on success metrics and program decisions.
  • Provide concise, effective communications regarding program status, accomplishments, risks, issues, and dependencies.
  • Present information to functional engineering management, engineering leadership, and executive leadership.
  • Collaborate with software, hardware, systems engineering, manufacturing, and operations teams to resolve issues and remove release blockers.
  • Demonstrate strong knowledge of one or more of the following:
  • Vehicle platforms
  • Software development lifecycles
  • Safety clearance processes
  • Test operations
  • Manage complex, cross-functional programs involving multiple technical and operational teams.
