  • This role does not require travel but demands a proactive, hands-on approach to software development and troubleshooting

job.title: Low Voltage Wire Harness Technician
job.description:
Low Voltage Wire Harness Technician

Build the Electrical Systems Behind Next-Generation Autonomous Vehicles

Overview

Join a hands-on engineering team developing autonomous systems, prototype vehicles, electrical platforms, and advanced test rigs across automotive, defense, trucking, and mining applications. As a Low Voltage Wire Harness Technician, you will fabricate, install, test, and troubleshoot 12V/24V wiring systems connecting computing platforms, sensors, drive-by-wire interfaces, data networks, and power distribution components.

This onsite, lab-based role combines precision bench fabrication with installation and validation on prototype vehicles and test benches. You will collaborate closely with design engineers to identify physical build issues, support engineering changes, maintain accurate as-built documentation, and improve the reliability of prototype fleets and test systems. High-voltage electrical work is strictly outside the scope of this position.

Key Responsibilities

  • Cut, strip, crimp, splice, shield, sleeve, label, and terminate low-voltage wire harnesses in accordance with IPC/WHMA-A-620 guidelines.
  • Install and route harnesses on prototype vehicles, including proper use of grommets, clips, strain relief, grounding, and clearance from heat sources and moving components.
  • Work with automotive connectors and terminals from manufacturers such as Deutsch, TE Connectivity, Molex, and Amphenol.
  • Fabricate breakout boxes, test fixtures, instrumentation harnesses, and related lab equipment.
  • Perform continuity, isolation, pull-force, and functional testing using digital multimeters, harness testers, pull testers, and basic CAN tools.
  • Troubleshoot opens, shorts, voltage drops, bad grounds, intermittent faults, connector wear, and other low-voltage wiring issues.
  • Rework harnesses based on Engineering Change Orders and maintain accurate revision records for each vehicle or test bench.
  • Update redlined drawings, pinout tables, bills of materials, wire lists, and as-built documentation when physical builds differ from design.
  • Collaborate proactively with design engineering and communicate build issues or drawing discrepancies.
  • Track tasks and priorities using tools such as JIRA and Slack.
  • Monitor wire, terminal, connector, and lab supply inventory and communicate replenishment needs.

Required Skills

  • At least 2 years of hands-on experience fabricating, installing, and troubleshooting low-voltage wire harnesses.
  • Experience in automotive, aerospace, robotics, drone, industrial, or comparable environments.
  • Proficiency with crimp tools, pull testers, digital multimeters, harness testers, and basic CAN tools.
  • Ability to read and interpret electrical schematics, harness drawings, pinout tables, and bills of materials.
  • Strong understanding of 12V/24V electrical systems, including:
  • Wire gauge selection
  • Circuit protection and fusing
  • Grounding
  • Strain relief
  • Harness routing and clearance requirements
  • Familiarity with automotive data interfaces such as CAN, Ethernet, GMSL, and USB.
  • Experience performing continuity, isolation, pull-force, and functional testing.
  • Ability to diagnose and resolve wiring faults, including opens, shorts, voltage drops, bad grounds, intermittent issues, and connector wear.
  • Ability to rework harnesses in accordance with Engineering Change Orders and maintain accurate revision records.
  • Strong attention to detail when documenting revisions, discrepancies, root causes, and corrective actions.
  • Proactive communication skills and the confidence to raise physical build issues and drawing discrepancies with engineering teams.
  • Ability to work inside prototype vehicles and in tight or physically demanding spaces.

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • IPC/WHMA-A-620 certification.
  • J-STD-001 soldering certification.
  • Experience working with harness CAD outputs such as Capital, RapidHarness, or CATIA Electrical.
  • Experience building breakout boxes, test fixtures, instrumentation harnesses, or lab test equipment.
  • Experience creating redlined drawings, pinout revisions, wire lists, and as-built documentation.
  • Familiarity with JIRA, Slack, or similar task and collaboration tools.
  • Experience monitoring and maintaining inventory of wire, terminals, connectors, and related lab supplies.
  • Background supporting prototype development, engineering changes, or complex electromechanical systems.

Preferred Education and Experience

  • At least 2 years of relevant hands-on low-voltage wire harness experience.
  • No specific degree or formal educational background is required.
  • Practical experience with harness fabrication, vehicle wiring, electrical testing, and troubleshooting is highly valued.
  • Experience supporting prototype vehicles, test platforms, or engineering development environments is beneficial.

Other Requirements

  • Work location: Fully onsite and lab-based in Sunnyvale, California.
  • Schedule: Flexible start times between 6:00 AM and 9:00 AM; typically 45–50 hours per week.
  • Overtime may be approved based on business needs.
  • Approximately 15% national travel may be required to support regional vehicle testing and field activities, with potential international travel.
  • Must be willing and able to travel as needed.
  • Contract-to-hire opportunity with an initial 6-month term and potential transition to direct hire.
  • High-voltage electrical work is strictly outside the scope of this position.

job.title: Meetings Manager
job.description:
Meetings Manager

Overview

Lead the day-to-day execution of a high-growth Meetings at Events program supporting Sales, Marketing, and go-to-market teams. As an interim Meetings Manager, you will step into an established global program and take ownership of meeting operations, event logistics, reporting, enablement, communications, and cross-functional coordination. This is a hands-on role for an experienced meetings or events professional who can operate with minimal ramp-up, maintain continuity across concurrent events, and create a well-documented transition for the incoming full-time team member.

This is a remote, six-month contract opportunity with travel required for on-site event execution.

Required Skills

  • 4–5 years of experience in meetings, events, or program management within a B2B enterprise software environment.
  • Experience owning the day-to-day operations of a meetings or events program from intake through execution and follow-up.
  • Ability to quickly step into an established program and maintain operations with minimal ramp-up.
  • Strong meeting and event operations experience, including:
  • Meeting-request intake, triage, approvals, scheduling, and real-time changes.
  • Meeting-tool setup, configuration, go-live, and quality assurance.
  • Venue logistics and space planning, including room setup, signage, access, attendee tracking, and food and beverage.
  • Event-day coordination and on-site execution.
  • Experience coordinating event logistics, meeting space, timelines, stakeholders, and budgets.
  • Strong analytical and reporting skills, including the ability to turn data exports into clear insights and leadership-ready recaps.
  • Proficiency with Google Sheets or Microsoft Excel.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to create clear enablement materials, process documentation, playbooks, guides, and program updates.
  • Highly organized and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple workstreams and event timelines under pressure.
  • Ability to work independently while aligning execution with program strategy.
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration skills across Marketing, Product, Sales, and event technology teams.
  • Ability to identify risks and dependencies, communicate issues clearly, and translate lessons learned into improved workflows.
  • Commitment to thorough documentation and clean operational handoffs.
  • Willingness to work outside standard hours when needed to support teams in other time zones.
  • Ability to travel as required for on-site event support.

Nice to Have Skills

  • Hands-on configuration experience with meeting and event platforms such as Jifflenow or RainFocus.
  • Experience with Tableau or other business intelligence and analytics tools.
  • Familiarity with Salesforce.
  • Familiarity with Asana.
  • Experience supporting global, first-party, and third-party events.
  • Experience developing training sessions, office hours, event support channels, and field communications.
  • Experience with pipeline attribution, event ROI reporting, and performance measurement against objectives.
  • Experience supporting large-scale data, technology, or industry events.

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Preferred education was not specified.
  • Preferred experience includes 4–5 years in meetings, events, or program management within a B2B enterprise software environment, with demonstrated ownership of end-to-end program operations.

Other Requirements

  • Work arrangement: Remote.
  • Engagement: Six-month interim contract.
  • Travel: Required for on-site event execution, including potential support for events in multiple regions.
  • Schedule: Flexibility to work off-hours may be required to align with regional teams across time zones.
  • Must be able to support meeting-tool go-live, event-day operations, post-event reporting, enablement, program communications, and documentation throughout the engagement.

job.title: System Integration and Test Engineer
job.description:
System Integration and Test Engineer

Overview

Drive the integration, testing, and reliability of complex vehicle-centric systems in an onsite engineering role based in Foster City, California. As a System Integration and Test Engineer, you will apply your expertise in electric vehicle development, systems engineering, and hands-on testing to evaluate system performance across Motion, Body, and electrical/electronic architecture domains. Your work will help identify integration risks, resolve complex issues, and support reliable vehicle performance in service operations.

Required Skills

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in Electrical Engineering or a related discipline
  • 6–8 years of experience in vehicle system development and testing roles
  • Experience with vehicle electrical architecture
  • Knowledge of automotive communication protocols, including:
  • CAN
  • LIN
  • Ethernet
  • Experience with instrumentation and data acquisition tools, such as:
  • Vector CANalyzer
  • ETAS INCA
  • Intrepid
  • CSM
  • Hands-on electrical troubleshooting experience using tools such as:
  • Digital multimeter
  • Oscilloscope
  • Electrical schematics
  • Saleae Logic Analyzer
  • Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting skills
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills

Responsibilities

job.title: Payroll Director
job.description:
Payroll Director

Overview

Lead the future of payroll operations for a complex North American organization supporting more than 10,000 employees across multiple locations and entities. The Payroll Director will oversee end-to-end U.S. payroll, time and attendance, compliance, systems, reporting, and continuous improvement in a heavily unionized environment governed by multiple Collective Bargaining Agreements (CBAs).

This strategic leadership role will guide a high-performing payroll function, partner with cross-functional teams, strengthen operational controls, and advance digitalization and automation initiatives. The ideal candidate is a highly technical payroll professional who combines deep multi-location payroll expertise with strong people leadership, business partnering, and change management capabilities.

Required Skills

  • 10+ years of progressive payroll management experience within a large, complex North American organization of 10,000+ employees
  • 6+ years of experience managing and developing skilled payroll teams
  • Bachelor’s degree or Certified Payroll Professional (CPP) designation
  • Extensive experience delivering payroll services in a heavily unionized environment with multiple CBAs
  • Strong knowledge of federal, state, and local payroll tax regulations, labor laws, internal controls, and compliance requirements
  • Proven experience implementing and managing large, multi-location U.S. payroll providers
  • Demonstrated success leading complex, cross-functional payroll projects
  • Strong expertise in time and attendance auditing, time control, leave tracking, and reporting
  • Experience overseeing complex biweekly and semimonthly payroll operations
  • Exceptional verbal, written, interpersonal, analytical, and business partnering skills
  • Ability to lead payroll operations across multiple locations and remote teams
  • Strong understanding of payroll controls, reconciliations, year-end processes, and performance reporting

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Experience with UKG HCM and payroll platforms
  • Strong experience with UKG Workforce Management, including Kronos/Dimensions and UTA
  • Background in business process digitalization and automation, including AI implementation
  • Experience developing payroll KPIs and enhancing analytical and reporting capabilities
  • Bilingual proficiency in English and French
  • Experience in the transit industry
  • Experience building or leading a Payroll Center of Excellence
  • Experience managing payroll operations involving complex union contracts and CBAs

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in accounting, finance, human resources, business administration, or a related field; or CPP designation
  • At least 10 years of progressive payroll experience in a large, multi-location organization
  • At least 6 years of experience leading payroll teams and managing managers or specialized payroll professionals
  • Experience supporting a workforce of more than 10,000 employees is strongly preferred

Key Responsibilities

  • Direct accurate, timely, and compliant U.S. payroll services across multiple entities and locations
  • Oversee payroll operations for both biweekly and semimonthly populations
  • Ensure payroll processes consistently align with applicable CBAs, labor laws, tax regulations, and internal controls
  • Serve as a functional subject matter expert for UKG HCM, Kronos/Dimensions, UTA, and related payroll systems
  • Lead time and attendance operations, including system configuration, workflow alignment, auditing, and leave tracking
  • Drive system enhancements, digitalization, automation, and AI-related initiatives
  • Develop business cases and present recommendations for payroll technology and process improvements
  • Establish and monitor payroll KPIs and strengthen reporting and analytical capabilities
  • Oversee year-end tax activities, including W-2s, 1042-S, T4s, and Records of Employment
  • Coach, mentor, and develop the payroll operations team
  • Provide matrixed guidance to related payroll and time and attendance functions
  • Partner with Finance, Human Resources, Operations, and other stakeholders to improve payroll service delivery and controls
  • Build and promote consistent best practices across the organization

Other Requirements

  • Work arrangement: Hybrid, with an expectation of working onsite in Boston approximately two to three days per week
  • Must be able to work Eastern Time business hours, generally 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m.
  • Flexibility to work outside standard hours during California payroll processing weeks
  • Relocation may be considered for qualified candidates
  • Business-casual dress environment
  • Must be comfortable leading teams distributed across Boston and other remote locations

job.title: Workday Consultant
job.description:
Workday Adaptive Planning Consultant

Overview

Drive meaningful planning transformation for higher education and public-sector organizations as a Workday Adaptive Planning Consultant. In this fully remote, client-facing contract role, you will help finance, budget, HR, academic, operational, and executive stakeholders modernize budgeting, forecasting, workforce planning, reporting, and long-range financial planning.

You will combine expertise in higher education and/or government finance with hands-on experience in solution design, model configuration, stakeholder engagement, and AI-accelerated delivery. From leading discovery workshops and translating business processes into scalable planning models to developing executive reporting and supporting go-live, you will help clients bring greater structure, accountability, and insight to complex financial environments.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead discovery workshops with Finance, Budget, HR, academic, administrative, operational, and executive stakeholders.
  • Design and configure Workday Adaptive Planning models, dashboards, reports, and reporting solutions.
  • Support budgeting, forecasting, workforce planning, enrollment and tuition revenue planning, long-range financial planning, grants and auxiliary planning, capital planning, and personnel budgeting initiatives.
  • Apply AI tools to accelerate configuration, documentation, testing, analysis, and delivery while validating the quality and accuracy of AI-generated output.
  • Support Workday Adaptive Decision Intelligence through scenario modeling, simulations, natural-language planning questions, and governed decision-making.
  • Translate organizational processes into scalable planning models and effective reporting solutions.
  • Conduct testing, validation, training, optimization, and go-live support.
  • Assist with roadmap development, optimization assessments, and process improvement initiatives.
  • Contribute to proposal development, demonstrations, and solution discussions.
  • Mentor junior consultants and support the development of consulting methodologies and AI accelerators.

Required Skills and Qualifications

  • At least 4 years of relevant experience in one or more of the following:
  • Higher education finance or budgeting
  • Government or public-sector budgeting and financial planning
  • FP&A or planning transformation consulting
  • Workday Adaptive Planning consulting or administration
  • Experience working within or supporting higher education institutions and/or government organizations.
  • Strong understanding of budgeting, forecasting, workforce planning, and financial reporting processes.
  • Experience leading client-facing meetings, discovery sessions, and workshops.
  • Ability to translate organizational business processes into scalable planning models.
  • Experience supporting solution design, testing, validation, training, or go-live activities.
  • Demonstrated ability to use AI tools effectively in a professional setting, including writing clear prompts, validating AI-generated output, and integrating AI into day-to-day delivery.
  • Strong analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with finance, budget, HR, academic, administrative, operational, and executive stakeholders.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced consulting environment.

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Active Workday Adaptive Planning certification.
  • Familiarity with Workday Adaptive Decision Intelligence or scenario-based, AI-driven planning.
  • Experience with enrollment planning, tuition and financial aid modeling, or faculty demand and workload planning.
  • Experience with workforce planning, personnel budgeting, or vacancy management.
  • Experience with long-range financial planning, grants management, fund forecasting, auxiliary planning, capital planning, or strategic initiative planning.
  • Knowledge of budget book and ACFR reporting processes.
  • Experience integrating planning solutions with ERP and SIS platforms such as Banner, Workday, Colleague, PeopleSoft, Ellucian, Tyler Technologies, Munis, Oracle, SAP, or other related systems.
  • Experience with OfficeConnect, dashboards, and executive reporting.
  • Experience applying AI tools to consulting, financial analysis, or modeling work.
  • Prior consulting experience.
  • Experience supporting proposals, demonstrations, or solution discussions.
  • Interest in mentoring junior consultants and contributing to consulting methodologies or AI accelerators.

Preferred Education and Experience

Relevant professional experience in higher education finance, government finance, public-sector planning, FP&A, Workday Adaptive Planning, or financial transformation consulting is preferred.

A minimum of 4 years of relevant professional experience is required. Specific degree requirements were not provided.

Other Requirements

  • Work arrangement: Fully remote.
  • Employment type: Contract or contract part-time.
  • Contract duration: 12 months or longer.
  • Travel: Periodic client travel may be required, generally less than 10% depending on project needs.
  • Availability to begin as soon as possible.
  • Ability to work effectively in a highly collaborative, autonomous, and client-facing consulting environment.
  • Commitment to quality, accountability, clear communication, and responsible use of AI in client delivery.

job.title: XOPs Validation Engineer
job.description:
XOPs Validation Engineer

Overview

Join a hands-on engineering team focused on transforming early-stage electro-mechanical prototypes into reliable, production-ready systems. As an XOPs Validation Engineer, you will serve as a critical connection between design engineering and cross-functional partners, developing and executing rigorous tests that expose design flaws, evaluate real-world performance, and accelerate product development.

This role is ideal for an experienced validation or reliability engineer who enjoys working directly with hardware, building creative test solutions, analyzing complex data, and investigating failures through root cause analysis.

Required Skills and Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Mechatronics, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a closely related discipline.
  • At least 3 years of experience in hardware testing, reliability engineering, or validation of complex electro-mechanical products.
  • Experience working with products such as robotics, medical devices, automotive systems, or consumer electronics.
  • Ability to develop, document, and execute comprehensive test plans, protocols, and standard operating procedures.
  • Experience defining validation requirements in collaboration with design engineers.
  • Hands-on proficiency with laboratory equipment, including:
  • Oscilloscopes
  • Digital multimeters
  • Power supplies
  • Load cells
  • Basic soldering and rework tools
  • Experience setting up data acquisition systems and working with sensors such as temperature, voltage, strain, torque, and acoustics.
  • Proficiency with 3D CAD for fixture design; CATIA experience is preferred.
  • Experience with scripting or programming languages such as Python, LabVIEW, MATLAB, or C++ for test automation and data parsing.
  • Strong understanding of statistical data analysis and Design of Experiments (DOE).
  • Familiarity with Failure Mode and Effects Analysis, including DFMEA and PFMEA.
  • Ability to conduct structural and functional testing, analyze results, and communicate findings clearly.
  • Experience performing teardown investigations and root cause analysis of mechanical, electrical, and functional failures.
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, including coordination with design engineering, purchasing, logistics, quality, and technical program management teams.

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Experience designing and building custom mechanical test fixtures and electrical harnesses.

Preferred Education and Experience

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience validating complex electro-mechanical hardware.
  • Experience in a fast-paced product development, prototyping, reliability, or hardware test environment is preferred.

Other Requirements

  • This is an onsite position in Foster City, California.
  • The anticipated engagement duration is 6 months.

  • This position is available on a W2 basis only.
  • The role requires hands-on work with prototype hardware, laboratory equipment, test fixtures, electrical harnesses, and data acquisition systems.

job.title: Senior Product Manager – Enterprise Storage Platform & Core OS
job.description:
About the Client & Opportunity

Our client is an industry leader in enterprise data storage platforms and next-generation data architecture. They are seeking an experienced Senior Product Manager to lead the roadmap and strategy for their core enterprise storage operating system and underlying hardware platform infrastructure.

In this role, you will sit at the intersection of enterprise software and hardware co-design. You will oversee critical platform initiatives, including controller optimization, flash media integration, fault tolerance/high availability, and seamless live updates.

Key Responsibilities

  • Core OS & Platform Roadmap: Own the product definition and strategic vision for core storage operating system services. Balance high-availability failover mechanisms, data reduction efficiency, and non-disruptive upgrade capabilities to maintain strict enterprise reliability standards.
  • Protocol & Systems Hardware Integration: Translate enterprise requirements across key block storage protocols (NVMe-oF, NVMe/TCP, Fibre Channel, iSCSI) into operational product specs that bridge new media and hardware controller innovations.
  • Data-Driven Roadmap Prioritization: Analyze system telemetry, benchmark analytics, and field performance data to uncover bottlenecks, optimize latency and throughput, and maintain a high-impact feature backlog.
  • Cross-Functional Co-Design: Partner closely with Platform Engineers, Systems QA, and Architecture teams to define technical acceptance criteria and deliver integrated hardware/software capabilities.
  • Field & Commercial Support: Create high-impact technical collateral, architectural positioning guides, and competitive insights to empower technical sales teams and enterprise customers.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Infrastructure Product Leadership: 5+ years of Product Management experience successfully defining and launching enterprise storage or infrastructure software capabilities.
  • Deep Storage Protocol Mastery: Hands-on expertise with block storage protocols (FC, iSCSI, NVMe-oF/TCP) and internal storage OS mechanics (controller architecture, high availability/failover, non-disruptive upgrades).
  • Analytical & Telemetry Focus: Proven ability to leverage benchmark telemetry and system metrics (IOPS, throughput, latency, failure domain dynamics) to make data-backed product choices.
  • Stakeholder Alignment: Strong track record of driving cross-functional initiatives and influencing engineering, hardware, and field teams without direct authority.


DeWinter Group and Maris Consulting is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. We post pay scales which are based on our client pay ranges. DeWinter, Maris, and our clients have the right to modify the requirements of the role which can impact the pay ranges posted.

job.title: Sustaining Engineer

job.title: Sr AP Analyst
job.description:
Senior Accounts Payable Analyst

Overview

Join a rapidly growing technology organization as a Senior Accounts Payable Analyst and take ownership of critical accounts payable, corporate expense, and payment operations. This is an opportunity to make an immediate impact in a high-volume, fast-paced environment where processes are continuously evolving and scalable financial controls are essential.

You will lead full-cycle accounts payable activities, manage corporate card and employee expense programs, support month-end close, and identify opportunities to improve systems and workflows. The ideal candidate is adaptable, highly organized, comfortable working with a lean team, and motivated to build efficient processes in a high-growth environment.

  • Manage significant and fluctuating transaction volume, including purchase orders, non-PO invoices, and expense documentation requiring follow-up.

Required Skills and Qualifications

  • Invoice intake and verification
  • General ledger coding
  • Purchase order matching
  • Approval routing
  • Vendor setup and maintenance
  • Payment processing
  • Issue resolution
  • Advanced experience administering Ramp, including approval workflows, transaction auditing, spend reporting, and troubleshooting.

  • Knowledge of vendor master file management, banking change controls, tax documentation, and audit-ready recordkeeping.
  • Proficiency with payment disbursements, payables aging, accruals, journal entries, and account reconciliations.
  • Experience supporting month-end close and resolving variances across card platforms, ledgers, and bank statements.
  • Strong understanding of internal controls and segregation of duties.
  • Advanced Excel skills, with the ability to analyze data, identify root causes, and maintain data integrity.
  • Ability to manage significant and fluctuating transaction volume while prioritizing competing deadlines.
  • Exceptional attention to detail, organization, follow-through, and communication.
  • Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively with employees, vendors, accounting, procurement, engineering, and other business partners.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, a related quantitative discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

Nice to Have Skills

  • Experience with Rillet, particularly AP, expense, reconciliation, and close workflows.

Other Requirements

  • Ability to coordinate effectively with internal teams, building management, and external vendors
  • Comfortable supporting office events, catering setups, meeting rooms, and presentation technology

Other Requirements

job.title: ECAD Library & PLM Engineer
job.description:
ECAD Library & PLM Engineer

Overview:
Join an innovative company at the forefront of hardware design and development as an ECAD Library & PLM Engineer. This role is vital for maintaining and advancing the electrical component library and ensuring seamless integration between ECAD and PLM systems. You will lead efforts to optimize library management, support manufacturing and NPI processes, and collaborate with cross-disciplinary teams to drive data quality and process efficiency in a fast-paced, high-tech environment. Your expertise will be instrumental in shaping the electronic design infrastructure that underpins cutting-edge product innovation.

Required Skills:

  • Deep hands-on experience with Altium Designer, including Altium 365, vaults, managed components, and library workflows
  • Proven ability to manage ECAD libraries end-to-end: schematic symbols, PCB footprints, models, and metadata
  • Strong knowledge of PLM system administration, ideally Dassault 3DEXPERIENCE / ENOVIA, including workflows and change management
  • Experience integrating ECAD and PLM systems, ensuring data synchronization and BOM consistency
  • Familiarity with CATIA and MCAD-ECAD data exchange protocols such as IDX/IDF and STEP
  • Solid understanding of electronics components, packages, datasheets, tolerances, and manufacturer part numbering standards
  • Excellent organizational skills with the ability to improve and maintain data quality initiatives like duplicate detection, obsolescence, EOL, and alternative parts

Nice to Have Skills:

  • Prior support for automotive, aerospace, or other regulated hardware programs
  • Experience with automotive component qualification standards (AEC-Q100/Q200) and functional safety documentation
  • Participation in PLM implementation, migration, or major upgrades
  • Experience supporting PCB layout for high-layer count boards (10+ layers)

Preferred Education and Experience:

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or related field
  • 6+ years of experience managing ECAD libraries, PLM systems, or electrical design data in hardware product environments

Other Requirements:

  • Onsite role based in Foster City, CA; candidates must be able to work onsite 5 days per week
  • Strong collaboration with mechanical engineering teams on CATIA/3DX interoperability for PCB 3D models and enclosure fit checks
  • Commitment to ensuring quality and accuracy in library data and electrical parts management to support manufacturing and NPI processes

job.title: IT Internal Auditor
job.description:
IT Internal Auditor – SOX & AI Risk

Overview

Support a high-growth SaaS organization as an IT Internal Auditor focused on strengthening its technology control environment during a period of rapid innovation. In this hands-on contract role, you will evaluate SOX compliance, assess IT risks associated with newly implemented AI tools, and design and test effective IT General Controls (ITGCs) and IT Application Controls (ITACs).

Working closely with IT teams, business process owners, internal stakeholders, and external auditors, you will assess control design, execute operating effectiveness testing, identify control gaps, and support remediation efforts. This is an opportunity to apply deep IT audit expertise in a dynamic technology environment where your work will directly support secure, compliant, and audit-ready business operations.

Required Skills

  • Eight or more years of IT audit experience within a Big 4 public accounting firm, major consulting organization, or internal audit function.
  • Strong hands-on experience with SOX ITGC and ITAC testing.
  • Experience designing and executing ITGC and ITAC test procedures across technology platforms and financial applications.
  • Knowledge of controls related to:
  • Logical access
  • Access provisioning and deprovisioning
  • User access reviews
  • Change management
  • Computer operations
  • Systems development lifecycle controls
  • Experience evaluating IT risks associated with SaaS platforms, cloud environments, and newly implemented technologies.
  • Experience assessing automated identity governance workflows and data integrity.
  • Experience with key report testing, including validation of report logic, parameters, completeness, and accuracy.
  • Ability to evaluate input, interface, processing, and output controls.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain risks, issues, and recommendations to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Excellent organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple workstreams and deadlines.
  • Ability to prepare clear, complete, and audit-ready documentation.
  • High level of integrity and discretion when handling confidential information.

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Experience assessing AI agents or AI-enabled tools and designing related ITGCs and ITACs.
  • Background working in a high-growth SaaS or technology organization.
  • Familiarity with COSO and emerging AI governance frameworks within a SOX environment.
  • Experience with financial or business processes such as quote-to-cash, revenue recognition, accounts receivable, or accounts payable.
  • Experience supporting operational audits, financial audits, or other internal audit projects.
  • Knowledge of AWS, Azure, ERP systems, and enterprise applications.
  • Experience creating process and data flow diagrams using Lucidchart, Visio, or comparable tools.
  • Experience supporting SOX or internal audit process improvement initiatives.
  • Familiarity with AuditBoard or a similar GRC platform.
  • CISA, CISSP, CPA, or an equivalent professional certification.

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Accounting, or a related field.
  • Eight or more years of progressive experience in IT audit, risk assurance, SOX compliance, or internal audit.
  • Experience in a Big 4, consulting, or high-growth technology environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently while partnering effectively with technical teams, business stakeholders, and audit leadership.

Other Requirements

  • Six-month contract assignment.
  • Full-time schedule of approximately 40 hours per week.
  • Hybrid work arrangement: three days onsite in Palo Alto and two days remote each week.
  • Reliable ability to commute to the Palo Alto worksite.
  • Immediate availability is preferred.

job.title: Senior Technical Systems Analyst/Systems Engineer
job.description:
Senior Technical Systems Analyst / Systems Engineer

Overview

Drive the technical readiness and delivery of cloud-native software platforms within a complex automotive technology environment. As a Senior Technical Systems Analyst / Systems Engineer, you will serve as a key bridge between Product Management, Software Engineering, and Project Management—transforming product vision into precise technical requirements, well-defined API contracts, scalable system designs, and execution-ready delivery plans.

You will evaluate technical feasibility, identify system dependencies, investigate integration issues, and support software initiatives through structured engineering processes and formal verification gates. This role is ideal for a technically fluent systems professional who excels at resolving ambiguity, connecting cross-functional teams, and guiding initiatives from requirements through release readiness.

Key Responsibilities

  • Translate product requirements into detailed Technical Requirement Documents (TRDs), technical specifications, and execution plans.
  • Define and review API specifications and contracts using REST, GraphQL, gRPC, OpenAPI 3.0, and Swagger.
  • Create sequence diagrams, document system interactions, and map cross-module software dependencies.
  • Evaluate technical feasibility and identify scope gaps, assumptions, edge cases, and error scenarios before development begins.
  • Partner with Product Managers to clarify requirements and align technical direction.
  • Collaborate with Software Engineering teams on Agile planning, backlog execution, effort estimation, and delivery scheduling.
  • Investigate integration test failures and system anomalies using logs, performance traces, and observability data.
  • Support root-cause analysis and resolution efforts with backend and engineering teams.
  • Help align software development activities with structured engineering processes and formal verification gates.
  • Organize test results, verification artifacts, and evidence packages required for evaluation and release readiness.
  • Maintain clear, accurate technical documentation throughout the software development lifecycle.

Required Skills and Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Systems Engineering, or a related technical field.
  • Five or more years of hands-on experience as a Systems Engineer, Technical Business Analyst, Solution Architect, Technical Program Manager, or similar professional supporting cloud-native software.
  • Proven ability to translate product requirements into detailed technical specifications and TRDs.
  • Strong knowledge of API design and integration, including REST, GraphQL, and gRPC.
  • Experience creating or reviewing API contracts using OpenAPI 3.0 and Swagger.
  • Ability to create sequence diagrams, define system interactions, and map software dependencies.
  • Experience conducting technical feasibility analysis and identifying scope ambiguities, assumptions, edge cases, and error conditions.
  • Hands-on experience troubleshooting integration issues using logs, performance traces, and observability platforms such as DataDog and AWS CloudWatch.
  • Experience with Jira, Confluence, Postman, Swagger, Jama Software, and AWS CloudWatch.
  • Strong understanding of software development lifecycles, requirements management, testing, and release readiness.
  • Strong analytical, documentation, communication, and problem-solving skills.
  • Business English fluency, both written and verbal.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with Product Management, Software Engineering, Project Management, and other cross-functional stakeholders.

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Japanese language proficiency at the JLPT N2 level or equivalent.
  • Experience working with automotive software platforms or connected-vehicle technologies.
  • Experience with ASPICE lifecycle processes, V-Model compliance, or other high-reliability software development frameworks.
  • Familiarity with ASPICE SYS.1–SYS.5 and SWE.1–SWE.6 process areas.
  • Experience working within ISO 26262 or another functional safety framework.
  • Experience supporting Agile sprint planning, backlog refinement, and delivery execution.
  • Experience gathering engineering estimates and developing project schedules.
  • Experience preparing verification artifacts, test documentation, and evidence packages for formal evaluation gates.
  • Experience analyzing system performance, integration failures, and backend service behavior.
  • Experience collaborating with distributed or cross-regional engineering teams.

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Systems Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • Five or more years of relevant professional experience in cloud-native software, systems engineering, technical analysis, solution architecture, or technical program delivery.
  • Professional experience in automotive or another highly structured software development environment.
  • Experience supporting requirements, architecture, integration, testing, and release activities across the software development lifecycle.

Other Requirements

  • Work arrangement: 100% onsite in Mountain View, California.
  • Schedule: Monday through Friday, 10:00 AM–7:00 PM Pacific Time.
  • Engagement: Contract-to-hire, beginning with an initial six-month contract.
  • Candidates must be able to work onsite five days per week during the required schedule.
  • Japanese language proficiency is highly valued for cross-regional collaboration.
  • Candidates must be comfortable organizing technical information, communicating across disciplines, documenting system decisions, and maintaining accurate delivery and verification records throughout the software development lifecycle.

job.title: Order Management Lead
job.description:
Order Management Lead

Overview

Lead global order management operations for a fast-paced SaaS organization during an approximately three-month temporary leave coverage assignment. In this hands-on leadership role, you will coordinate across Salesforce, Product, Deal Desk, Revenue Accounting, GTM, and NetSuite to ensure accurate, compliant, and timely order processing throughout the quote-to-cash lifecycle.

As the final reviewer for opportunities moving to closed/won, you will validate order completeness, resolve deal exceptions and booking blockers, monitor order data flows, and strengthen audit-ready controls. This is an opportunity for an experienced order management professional to make an immediate impact across systems, processes, and global stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead day-to-day global order management operations and oversee order processing activities.
  • Conduct final reviews of opportunities moving to closed/won in Salesforce.
  • Validate order completeness, accuracy, and compliance with bookings policies, revenue recognition principles, and SOX standards.
  • Partner with Deal Desk, GTM, Revenue Accounting, Finance, Legal, Product, and Sales teams to review contracts and resolve booking blockers.
  • Monitor order data flows across Salesforce, Product platforms, and NetSuite.
  • Identify and resolve integration, system synchronization, and order data issues.
  • Conduct root cause analysis and recommend process or system improvements.
  • Develop and document exception-handling playbooks, standard operating procedures, and operational controls.
  • Support month-end and quarter-end close activities.
  • Assist with internal and external audit requests related to order operations.
  • Lead or mentor global team members and communicate effectively across time zones.

Required Skills

  • Six or more years of experience in SaaS order management, Deal Desk, revenue accounting, billing, or a related function.
  • Demonstrated expertise with Salesforce CPQ and NetSuite.
  • Strong understanding of bookings policies, revenue recognition principles, and SOX control frameworks.
  • Experience reviewing contracts, validating order completeness, and resolving deal or booking exceptions.
  • Ability to manage order data flows across Salesforce, Product platforms, and NetSuite.
  • Proven experience conducting root cause analysis and driving process or system improvements.
  • Experience leading or mentoring global teams across multiple time zones.
  • Ability to work independently, prioritize competing needs, and resolve issues in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong analytical skills and comfort working with dashboards, reports, and operational data.
  • Excellent written, verbal, and cross-functional communication skills.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Experience with order synchronization or integration tools such as Celigo.
  • Familiarity with Jira, Looker, Avalara, Google Workspace, and other quote-to-cash or order-to-cash tools.
  • Experience creating exception-handling playbooks, standard operating procedures, or process documentation.
  • Experience supporting month-end and quarter-end close activities.
  • Experience assisting with internal or external audits related to order operations.
  • Background in a scale-up or post-merger environment.
  • Experience partnering with Deal Desk, GTM, Revenue Accounting, Finance, Legal, Product, or Sales teams.

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Six or more years of relevant experience in SaaS order management, Deal Desk, revenue accounting, billing, or a closely related field.
  • Experience supporting complex quote-to-cash operations in a global organization.
  • No specific degree or educational credential is required for this position.

Other Requirements

  • Work arrangement: 100% remote.
  • Engagement: Approximately three-month temporary assignment.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with global stakeholders across time zones.
  • Ability to support month-end and quarter-end close activities as needed.
  • Strong proficiency with Salesforce CPQ and NetSuite.
  • Comfort working in a hands-on operational leadership role and managing day-to-day order management activities during a leave coverage period.

job.title: HIL-SRS Data Center Technician
job.description:
HIL-SRS Data Center Technician

Overview

Support the test infrastructure that helps validate autonomous vehicle software as a HIL-SRS Data Center Technician. This onsite role is responsible for building, maintaining, configuring, and troubleshooting simulation machines and test platforms used throughout the autonomous software development process.   • Strong organizational and documentation skills

job.title: Model Maker - Additive Focus
job.description:
Model Maker – Additive Focus

Overview

Turn engineering and design concepts into high-fidelity physical prototypes and appearance models for innovative autonomous vehicle programs. As a Model Maker with an additive manufacturing focus, you’ll work hands-on with engineers, designers, and prototype fabrication specialists to select the right materials and processes, operate multiple 3D-printing platforms, and transform experimental concepts into accurate, finished physical parts. This is an onsite, highly collaborative role where your craftsmanship, technical judgment, and ability to move quickly will directly support high-impact development work.

Required Skills

  • 2–5 years of hands-on experience in additive manufacturing, model making, or prototype fabrication.
  • Working knowledge of SLA, SLS, FDM, and PolyJet processes and materials, including tradeoffs among speed, strength, and surface finish.
  • Experience preparing, nesting, slicing, and running additive manufacturing builds.
  • Ability to troubleshoot common build issues, including warping, adhesion problems, and support failures.
  • Experience with build-preparation or slicing software such as GrabCAD Print, Materialise Magics, Autodesk Fusion with additive manufacturing extensions, or similar tools.
  • Ability to read and navigate CAD models using SolidWorks, CATIA, or comparable software.
  • Ability to interpret technical drawings and GD&T callouts.
  • Proficiency with precision measurement tools, including calipers and micrometers.
  • Hands-on finishing skills, including support removal, sanding, priming, painting, bonding, dyeing, insert installation, and assembly.
  • Ability to review CAD designs for printability and provide Design for Additive Manufacturing feedback.
  • Experience assembling prototypes and integrating printed parts with CNC-machined, laser-cut, purchased, and electronic components.
  • Ability to manage an assigned request queue, prioritize work, and meet deadlines with light supervision.
  • Clear communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with engineers, designers, and other fabrication disciplines.
  • Ability to perform routine equipment maintenance and first-line troubleshooting.
  • Commitment to lab safety and material-handling procedures.

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Experience creating or editing CAD surfaces and printable parts or fixtures.
  • Experience with paint matching, surface texturing, or appearance and ergonomic models.
  • Experience with additional prototyping methods, such as:
  • CNC operation
  • Laser cutting
  • MIG/TIG welding
  • Foam, wood, urethane, or clay modeling
  • Experience with OSHA-compliant shop practices.
  • Experience handling hazardous materials in a fabrication or prototyping environment.
  • Familiarity with JIRA or similar workflow and request-management tools.

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, industrial design, or a related field, or equivalent hands-on experience.
  • 2–5 years of relevant experience in additive manufacturing, model making, prototype fabrication, or a comparable technical production environment.

Other Requirements

  • Work arrangement: Onsite in Foster City, California.
  • Engagement: 12-month assignment.
  • Ability to work hands-on in a prototype fabrication lab and follow applicable safety and material-handling protocols.
  • Ability to coordinate with vendors for additive equipment service when required.
  • W2 engagement only.

job.title: Program Manager – Manufacturing Systems & Processes
job.description:
Program Manager – Manufacturing Systems & Processes

Overview

Lead high-impact programs that strengthen the systems, processes, and operational foundations supporting modern manufacturing. This role will drive enterprise systems implementation, integration, process improvement, and organizational adoption across manufacturing operations. Working closely with Manufacturing Operations, Safety, HR, IT, Business Applications, and external vendors, you will translate complex operational needs into scalable solutions that improve efficiency, consistency, data quality, compliance, and visibility.

The ideal candidate combines strong program leadership with hands-on experience in enterprise systems, business process transformation, cross-functional coordination, and measurable operational improvement.

Required Skills

  • 8+ years of program or project management experience, including 5+ years leading complex, cross-functional enterprise systems implementations, business transformation initiatives, or comparable programs
  • Demonstrated experience implementing, integrating, or improving enterprise business systems
  • Ability to translate business requirements into actionable implementation plans and measurable outcomes
  • Experience in one or more of the following areas:
  • Workforce Management (WFM)
  • Human Resources Information Systems (HRIS)
  • Learning Management Systems (LMS)
  • Environment, Health and Safety (EHS)
  • Time and attendance
  • Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP)
  • Comparable enterprise applications
  • Strong understanding of business processes and systems, including:
  • Requirements definition
  • Process design
  • System dependencies
  • Integrations and data flows
  • Reporting
  • Data quality
  • Experience leading programs from current-state assessment and requirements gathering through solution design, implementation, deployment, and post-launch stabilization
  • Proven ability to lead cross-functional stakeholders, technical teams, implementation partners, and vendors
  • Strong experience managing scope, schedules, resources, dependencies, risks, issues, decisions, and status reporting
  • Ability to resolve competing priorities and drive decisions in ambiguous environments
  • Experience supporting change management through stakeholder engagement, communications, training, deployment readiness, and post-launch support
  • Strong communication, organizational, analytical, and execution skills
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities while communicating effectively with operational teams and senior leadership

Nice to Have Skills

  • Experience supporting manufacturing, industrial operations, logistics, or other frontline, shift-based workforces
  • Exposure to multiple workforce or safety platforms, such as Workday, Beeline, VNDLY, UKG, SAP, Docebo, or comparable systems
  • Experience coordinating system integrations, APIs, data migration, identity and access management, or enterprise reporting
  • Familiarity with Lean methodologies, business process reengineering, and continuous improvement
  • Experience managing multi-system implementations or a portfolio of interconnected enterprise applications
  • Experience defining operational KPIs and using data to evaluate program effectiveness and business outcomes
  • Experience scaling enterprise systems and standardized processes in a rapidly growing operational environment
  • PMP, CSM, SAFe, or equivalent program management certification

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, Business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
  • 8+ years of program or project management experience
  • 5+ years of experience leading complex enterprise systems implementations, business transformation initiatives, or comparable programs
  • Experience delivering systems and process improvements that support manufacturing operations or other complex operational environments

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead end-to-end systems programs across Safety, Workforce Management, Quality Management, Learning Management, Asset Management, and related manufacturing operations systems
  • Assess current-state workflows, gather requirements, identify gaps and inefficiencies, and define future-state processes
  • Partner with Manufacturing Operations, Safety, HR, IT, Business Applications, and external vendors to align requirements, priorities, and implementation plans
  • Coordinate system integrations and data flows supporting training, hiring, onboarding, scheduling, time and attendance, safety, and operational reporting
  • Partner with technical teams to address system dependencies, data quality, integration needs, and reporting requirements
  • Establish and maintain program governance, including scope, schedules, resources, risks, issues, decisions, dependencies, and stakeholder communications
  • Drive change management and organizational adoption through communications, training, deployment readiness, and post-launch support
  • Measure system adoption, process compliance, operational impact, and business outcomes
  • Manage vendor commitments, implementation deliverables, and continuous improvement activities
  • Identify opportunities to improve system effectiveness, process standardization, data quality, operational visibility, and scalability

Other Requirements

  • Work arrangement: Hybrid
  • Location: Foster City, CA
  • Engagement: W2 only
  • Expected duration: 1 year
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with onsite and cross-functional operational teams
  • No travel or additional certification requirements were provided for this position

Success in This Role

  • Successful delivery of prioritized manufacturing systems and process improvement programs
  • Clear ownership of requirements, dependencies, risks, decisions, and cross-functional commitments
  • Improved integration and consistency across training, hiring, scheduling, timekeeping, safety, and related operational workflows
  • Increased system adoption, data quality, operational visibility, and process compliance
  • Measurable improvements in process efficiency and effectiveness through scalable systems and standardized workflows supporting manufacturing growth

job.title: Tax Consultant
job.description:
Tax Consultant – SaaS Sales Tax & Tax Provision

Overview

Join a growing SaaS technology organization as a hands-on Tax Consultant supporting a high-impact sales tax remediation and year-end tax initiative. This fully remote consulting engagement will initially focus on investigating and remediating historical U.S. sales and use tax exposure across multiple states, including economic nexus, SaaS taxability, registrations, filings, reconciliations, and supporting documentation.

As the engagement progresses, you will transition into direct tax responsibilities, including year-end tax provision preparation and audit support. The ideal candidate is an independent, execution-focused tax professional who can analyze detailed transaction data, collaborate with General Ledger and Revenue teams, and develop practical solutions with minimal oversight.

Required Skills

  • Four or more years of relevant experience in corporate tax, public accounting, or tax consulting.
  • Hands-on experience with U.S. sales and use tax for a SaaS or software organization.
  • Strong understanding of multistate sales tax compliance, including:
  • Economic nexus
  • SaaS taxability
  • State registrations
  • Sales tax filings
  • Experience investigating and resolving sales tax discrepancies, historical exposures, and compliance issues.
  • Ability to analyze transaction-level data, billing records, tax data, and General Ledger activity.
  • Experience preparing reconciliations, schedules, workpapers, and supporting documentation.
  • Foundational knowledge of corporate income taxation.
  • Familiarity with tax provision processes under ASC 740.
  • Strong Excel skills and comfort working with financial, billing, tax, and transaction data.
  • Ability to work independently, research unfamiliar issues, and execute solutions without extensive direction.
  • Willingness to perform detailed, hands-on work regardless of previous title or management experience.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with General Ledger, Revenue, Tax, Accounting, and audit stakeholders.

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Previous in-house Tax Senior or Tax Manager experience within a SaaS or technology company.
  • Experience conducting historical sales tax exposure analyses and remediation initiatives.
  • Experience with voluntary disclosure agreements, state registrations, and delinquent tax filings.
  • Experience supporting quarterly or annual tax provision preparation under ASC 740.
  • Familiarity with Anrok, NetSuite, Chargebee, or Stripe.
  • Experience with tax technology, billing platforms, and enterprise resource planning systems.
  • Experience supporting tax audits, tax research, tax notices, or broader tax process improvement initiatives.

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Four or more years of relevant experience in corporate tax, public accounting, or tax consulting, preferably within a SaaS or software environment.
  • Experience supporting both indirect tax and direct tax activities is preferred.
  • Specific educational requirements were not provided for this position.

Other Requirements

  • Work arrangement: Fully remote.
  • Start date: As soon as possible.
  • Engagement: Initially three months, with potential for extension or conversion.
  • Comfortable supporting an immediate sales tax remediation initiative before transitioning into year-end direct tax and tax provision work.
  • Ability to manage detailed, deadline-sensitive work and maintain organized documentation across multiple tax matters.
  • Comfortable partnering virtually with cross-functional accounting and finance teams.

job.title: Technical Program Coordinator
job.description:
Technical Program Coordinator

Overview

Lead high-impact, cross-functional engineering programs that shape how complex technical initiatives are planned, executed, and delivered. This role partners closely with senior engineering and product leadership to drive strategic programs across multiple teams, systems, and business lines.

The ideal candidate brings strong technical intuition, exceptional organizational skills, and a proven ability to create alignment in fast-paced, ambiguous environments. You will guide programs from strategy through delivery, manage dependencies and risks, contribute to technical discussions, and translate complex engineering concepts into clear business impact.

Required Skills

  • 7+ years of experience in technical program management.

  • Excellent problem-solving, troubleshooting, and debugging abilities.

  • Ability to collaborate effectively with multiple engineering, product, and business teams.

job.title: Senior Machine Learning Hardware Design Consultant
job.description:
Senior Machine Learning Hardware Design Consultant

Overview

Shape the core technology behind high-performance machine learning accelerator IP. As a Senior Machine Learning Hardware Design Consultant, you will design and implement specialized digital hardware that translates mathematically complex algorithms into efficient, synthesizable silicon.

This is a hands-on ASIC hardware design role—not a machine learning software position. You will own complex core logic across the design lifecycle, from microarchitecture definition and RTL development through integration, timing closure, verification support, and silicon bring-up. Working closely with architecture, verification, physical design, firmware, and hardware engineering teams, you will help optimize designs for performance, power, area, and overall Quality of Results (QOR).

Required Skills

  • Strong digital hardware and logic design fundamentals
  • Expert-level RTL design experience using Verilog and/or SystemVerilog
  • Proven experience designing complex blocks from specification and microarchitecture through RTL implementation and integration
  • Experience implementing complex algorithms or computational features in hardware
  • Several years of experience working with machine learning-related hardware or algorithms
  • Strong understanding of the mathematics underlying machine learning, graphics, and/or digital signal processing algorithms
  • Ability to translate mathematically complex concepts into efficient, performance-sensitive hardware
  • Hands-on experience with synthesis, timing constraints, timing closure, and DFT concepts
  • Experience collaborating with physical design engineers to achieve timing closure
  • Strong understanding of QOR and hardware optimization for power, performance, and area
  • Experience designing specialized core logic rather than general peripheral or side logic
  • Understanding of microarchitectural trade-offs, datapath and control logic design, and block-level optimization
  • Ability to collaborate effectively across architecture, verification, physical design, firmware, and hardware engineering teams

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Direct experience designing machine learning accelerator hardware
  • Experience with 3D graphics hardware
  • Experience with digital signal processing hardware or algorithms
  • Experience integrating blocks into larger SoCs
  • Experience with Synopsys design tools
  • Exposure to firmware or driver development
  • Experience with other ASIC and hardware design toolsets; tool-specific experience is secondary to demonstrated design expertise

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field preferred
  • At least 5 years of ASIC design experience, with a strong focus on block-level RTL design and silicon development
  • 10+ years of digital or hardware design experience strongly preferred
  • Demonstrated success taking blocks from microarchitecture and RTL through working silicon
  • Experience applying machine learning, graphics, DSP, or related algorithms to hardware implementations

Other Requirements

  • Location: San Jose, CA
  • Work arrangement: Onsite preferred; flexibility may be considered for exceptional candidates
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, highly specialized, and performance-sensitive hardware development environment
  • Availability to begin within approximately four weeks is preferred
  • Two positions are available

job.title: Functional Safety Consultant – Semiconductor / Silicon

As a Functional Safety Consultant, you will work within a silicon development environment to integrate Functional Safety throughout the product lifecycle and help drive semiconductor designs toward ASIL-B certification.

You will collaborate with silicon design and engineering teams, lead critical safety analyses, apply industry standards, and develop the technical documentation required to advance semiconductor products through certification. This role requires direct semiconductor- or silicon-level Functional Safety experience; experience limited exclusively to vehicle- or system-level Functional Safety does not meet the technical requirements for this engagement.

  • Demonstrated Functional Safety experience within a semiconductor or silicon development environment
  • Strong knowledge of ISO 26262
  • Experience applying ASIL requirements, specifically ASIL-B
  • Hands-on experience performing or leading:
  • Failure Modes, Effects, and Diagnostic Analysis (FMEDA)
  • Failure Modes and Effects Analysis (FMEA)
  • Hazard Analysis and Risk Assessment (HARA)
  • Experience supporting semiconductor products through Functional Safety certification
  • Understanding of AEC-Q100 and automotive semiconductor qualification and reliability requirements
  • Knowledge of ISO 21434 and automotive cybersecurity concepts
  • Ability to apply Functional Safety requirements throughout the silicon development lifecycle
  • Strong technical documentation and analysis skills
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with silicon design and engineering teams

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Extensive experience with automotive-grade semiconductor development
  • Experience owning or leading Functional Safety activities through certification
  • Experience driving Functional Safety requirements across the silicon development lifecycle

Preferred Education and Experience

A specific educational background has not been provided for this position. Candidates should bring at least 5 years of directly relevant Functional Safety experience in a semiconductor or silicon development environment, with approximately 10+ years preferred.

Other Requirements

  • Engagement: Contract position expected to last 6+ months
  • Must have semiconductor- or silicon-level Functional Safety experience
  • Candidates whose experience is exclusively at the vehicle or system level will not meet the technical requirements for this role
  • Must be able to support Functional Safety activities, technical analysis, and certification documentation throughout the silicon development lifecycle

This role offers the opportunity to apply strong technical judgment across the system lifecycle, ensure data integrity and intended use, support inspection readiness, and guide multiple complex projects with minimal supervision. You will play a key role in validating cloud-based and SaaS platforms, assessing emerging AI capabilities, supporting data migrations, and strengthening CSV procedures and documentation.

  • Substantial hands-on experience delivering validation projects.
  • Strong knowledge of:
  • GxP requirements
  • 21 CFR Part 11
  • EU Annex 11
  • GAMP 5
  • Computerized system data integrity principles and controls
  • Demonstrated ability to apply risk-based CSV methods and computer software assurance (CSA) principles across the system lifecycle.
  • Knowledge of software development and lifecycle methodologies.
  • Experience authoring, reviewing, and assessing validation documentation, including:
  • Validation plans
  • User requirements
  • Functional and configuration specifications
  • Risk assessments
  • Test protocols
  • Requirements traceability matrices
  • Validation summary reports
  • Experience executing or coordinating validation testing, documenting objective evidence, investigating discrepancies, and tracking issues through resolution.
  • Experience supporting system implementations, change control, remediation, and software upgrades.
  • Experience validating cloud-based SaaS systems and evaluating vendor documentation within a risk-based validation strategy.
  • Experience working with study-level electronic systems, including:
  • Electronic data capture (EDC)
  • Interactive response technology (IRT)
  • Pharmacovigilance (PV) databases
  • Experience assessing electronic records and electronic signatures requirements.
  • Experience assessing data integrity controls, including access management, audit trails, and electronic signatures.

job.title: CAD Engineer - HV Dist & Charging System
job.description:
CAD Engineer - HV Distribution & Charging System

Join a forward-thinking team at the forefront of high-voltage electrical design in the rapidly evolving mobility industry. As a CAD Engineer specializing in HV Distribution and Charging Systems, you will develop critical components that power innovative electric vehicles, impacting sustainable transportation worldwide. Your expertise will drive the design and optimization of high-voltage junction boxes, insulator trays, busbars, and harness routing—key elements necessary for cutting-edge vehicle architectures.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Design and develop mechanical components including enclosures, brackets, and assemblies for high-voltage systems.
  • Create detailed 3D CAD models and 2D engineering drawings using CATIA V6 that meet rigorous specifications.
  • Manage updates and revisions of models in collaboration with part and assembly owners.
  • Generate parametric content for standard model libraries to support efficient design reuse.
  • Assist packaging teams by developing CAD for mock-ups, restriction geometries, and volume definitions.
  • Support manufacturing readiness with robust, manufacturable designs considering plastic and metallic part processes.
  • Conduct design reviews, including tolerance stack-ups and interface analyses, ensuring alignment with system requirements.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including Mechatronics and electrical engineers, to define and refine integrated solutions.

Required Skills & Qualifications:

  • 2-4 years of hands-on experience in 3D CAD modeling, preferably with CATIA V6.
  • Proficiency in creating fully parametric solids, including Boolean operations and sketches.
  • Strong understanding of plastic and metallic part design and manufacturing processes.
  • Ability to conduct basic tolerance analyses and stack-ups.
  • Knowledge of Mechatronics system integration, PCB assembly (PCBA), and interface development.
  • Skilled in interpreting and generating drawings compliant with ASME Y14.5 standards and GD&T principles.
  • Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Office, Google Docs, and project management tools such as JIRA.
  • Customer-centric mindset with flexibility to work varied hours as needed.

Nice-to-Have Skills:

  • Experience with 3DX or similar advanced CAD platforms.
  • Background in high-voltage or automotive electrical systems design.
  • Knowledge of DFx activities and design for manufacturability considerations.

Preferred Education & Experience:

  • Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
  • Prior experience in the automotive, transportation, or electric vehicle industry is a plus.

Additional Requirements:

  • This position is based on-site in Foster City, CA, with the possibility of flexible working arrangements.
  • No travel requirements.
  • Valid certifications related to mechanical or electrical design are beneficial but not mandatory.

Embark on a career that powers the future of sustainable mobility, crafting the high-voltage systems that make electric vehicles safer, more reliable, and more efficient.

job.title: SEO/AEO Content Operations Manager
job.description:

Working under the strategic direction of the SEO/AEO Program Lead, this role serves as a central point of coordination among SEO/AEO, Product Marketing, Content, Legal, external agencies, and other stakeholders. The ideal candidate is highly organized, analytical, detail-oriented, and skilled at moving multiple initiatives from planning through implementation while maintaining quality, governance, and timeline requirements.

Key Responsibilities

  • Review existing content to identify outdated, underperforming, duplicate, or obsolete assets.

  • Coordinate implementation of optimization priorities based on business objectives and established strategic direction.
  • Support SEO and AEO strategy execution across digital content properties.
  • Research emerging search trends, prompts, and AI-driven discovery experiences.
  • Identify opportunities to improve content visibility and performance in traditional and AI-powered search environments.
  • Ensure content updates align with approved optimization strategies, editorial standards, and campaign priorities.
  • Coordinate end-to-end review workflows with Product Marketing, Content, Legal, and other stakeholders.
  • Track approvals, follow up on outstanding actions, and help drive projects through completion.
  • Maintain clear communication regarding project status, timelines, and dependencies.
  • Review deliverables from external SEO agencies, consultants, and strategic partners.
  • Validate recommendations for quality, completeness, and alignment with SEO/AEO best practices.
  • Coordinate implementation efforts with internal teams and ensure recommendations are executed effectively.
  • Perform quality assurance reviews before publication.
  • Ensure content complies with SEO, AEO, accessibility, schema markup, and content governance requirements.
  • Identify issues, escalate risks, and recommend corrective actions.
  • Monitor content optimization projects, implementation activities, and stakeholder requests.
  • Track progress against project timelines and milestones.
  • Identify and mitigate blockers that could affect delivery.
  • Provide regular status updates and reporting to stakeholders and program leadership.

Required Skills

  • Hands-on SEO/AEO experience, including content optimization, search best practices, and AI-powered search environments.
  • Strong organizational and project management skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple initiatives, coordinate cross-functional reviews, follow up consistently, and keep projects moving forward.
  • Analytical thinking and strong attention to detail.
  • Ability to evaluate performance data, identify opportunities, and translate insights into clear, actionable recommendations.
  • Familiarity with SEO best practices, keyword research, content optimization, schema markup, and search performance metrics.
  • Understanding of Answer Engine Optimization and AI-powered search experiences.
  • Strong stakeholder management and cross-functional coordination skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities across cross-functional teams.
  • Proactive problem-solving and risk-escalation skills.
  • Commitment to quality assurance, process improvement, and operational excellence.
  • Comfort working in both traditional SEO and emerging AI search environments.

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Experience working with content management systems, marketing platforms, and SEO tools.
  • Experience with Google Search Console and Bing Webmaster Tools.
  • Experience with Adobe Analytics.
  • Experience with SEMrush, Ahrefs, or similar SEO platforms.

  • Familiarity with large language models and AI tools, including Gemini, Copilot, or ChatGPT.

  • Preferred educational background was not specified in the provided job information.

Other Requirements

  • Employment type: W2 only.
  • Start date: ASAP.
  • Ability to coordinate effectively with multiple internal teams and external partners.
  • Ability to maintain project visibility, meet deadlines, and communicate status, dependencies, and risks consistently.

job.title: Fleet Support Engineer
job.description:

Support the operational uptime and reliability of an autonomous vehicle fleet as an on-site technical expert in Atlanta. The Fleet Support Engineer serves as the primary point of contact for real-time sensor-related escalations, partnering closely with Vehicle Technicians and Component and Hardware Engineering teams to diagnose complex issues, improve troubleshooting processes, and reduce vehicle downtime.

This role is ideal for an experienced engineer who combines strong sensor and vehicle systems expertise with a hands-on, analytical approach to root cause investigation. You will review fleet and sensor data, validate new hardware, develop diagnostic procedures, and implement fleet-wide countermeasures that improve vehicle performance and reliability.

Required Skills and Qualifications
